items.name: Duskfield Grenade
items.description: A grenade that shatters on impact, leaving behind a field that slows targets and freezes those who do not leave the volume.
items.descriptionZh: 手雷会在撞击时碎裂，留下一片减速目标的力场，未离开力场范围的敌人会被冻结。

items.name: Glacier Grenade
items.description: A grenade that creates walls out of [Stasis] Stasis crystals to block damage and freeze targets; these walls can be shattered for damage.
items.descriptionZh: 手雷可制造出冰影水晶所形成的墙壁以阻挡伤害和冻结目标；可以碎裂这些墙壁来制造伤害。

items.name: Shatter Grenade
items.description: A grenade that sticks to combatants before exploding into razor-sharp [Stasis] Stasis shrapnel. The shrapnel ricochets off surfaces, dealing damage to all in its path. Hitting a frozen target shatters it instantly and deals bonus damage.
items.descriptionZh: 一种会粘附在战斗人员身上，然后爆炸成锋利冰影弹片的手雷。弹片会在表面弹射，对路径上的一切造成伤害。命中被冻结的目标会立即将其击碎并造成额外伤害。

items.name: Coldsnap Grenade
items.description: A grenade that freezes on impact and sends another seeker to find and freeze targets.
items.descriptionZh: 手雷命中后会冻结敌人并释放另一颗跟踪雷来寻找并冻结目标。

items.name: Strafe Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并凭借强劲的方向控制开始空中漂移。

items.name: Burst Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以强大的初始爆发速度开始空中漂移。

items.name: Balanced Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以适当的速度和方向控制开始空中漂移。

items.name: Blink
items.description: Jump while airborne to teleport a short distance.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可触发一小段距离的传送。

items.name: Triple Jump
items.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时进行第二次或第三次跳跃可保持在空中。

items.name: High Jump
items.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时再次跳跃可上升到更高的高度。

items.name: Strafe Jump
items.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时凭借强劲的方向控制再次进行跳跃。

items.name: Empowering Rift
items.description:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
items.descriptionZh:
制造光能源泉，为位于其中的角色增加武器伤害和技能能量回复。

击败站在裂痕中的战斗人员可以获得额外弹药生成。

items.name: Healing Rift
items.description: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造能量源泉，为位于其中的角色提供持续治疗。

perkDetails.name: Facet of Defiance
perkDetails.description: Finishers create a detonation that either jolts, scorches, slows, severs, or makes targets volatile based on the damage type of your equipped Super.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 终结技会基于你已装备超能的伤害类型，产生一次对目标造成震颤、灼烧、减速、割裂或不稳定的爆炸。

perkDetails.name: +10 Class ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Class ▲

perkDetails.name: Hellion
perkDetails.description:
Activate your class ability to summon a [Solar] Solar mortar that lobs flaming projectiles at distant targets. Targets damaged by the mortar are scorched.

Hellion damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
启动你的职业技能来召唤一个可向远处目标发射火焰射弹的烈日迫击炮。被迫击炮伤害的目标会被灼烧。

地狱火的伤害会根据手雷属性强化增益进行调整。

perkDetails.name: Touch of Flame
perkDetails.description:
Your Healing, Solar, Firebolt, and Fusion Grenades have enhanced functionality.

Healing Grenade: Improves the strength of cure and restoration effects applied. Consuming a Healing Grenade with Heat Rises also applies restoration to nearby allies.

Solar Grenade: Increases linger duration. Periodically emits blobs of lava around its perimeter.

Firebolt Grenade: Increases target search radius and maximum target count.

Fusion Grenade: Explodes twice.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你的治愈、烈日、烈焰和融合手雷功能增强。

治愈手雷：提高所施加的治愈和恢复效果的强度。 炙热升腾时消耗治愈手雷还会对附近的盟友提供恢复效果。

烈日手雷：提升持续时间。在其周围周期性地发射熔岩团块。

烈焰手雷：提升目标搜寻范围和最大目标数。

融合手雷：可爆炸两次。

perkDetails.name: Heat Rises
perkDetails.description:
You can fire weapons, melee, and throw grenades while gliding.

[Grenade]  : Hold to consume your grenade, gaining Heat Rises and releasing a burst of healing energy that cures nearby allies. The strength of the burst is increased when a Healing Grenade is consumed.

Final blows while airborne increase the duration of Heat Rises and grant melee energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
滑行时可使用武器射击、发动近战和投掷手雷。

[手雷]  ：按住来消耗手雷，可获得炙热升腾并爆发治疗能量，来治愈 附近的盟友。消耗治愈手雷时，爆发强度将会提升。

在空中时造成最后一击可提升炙热升腾的持续时间并提供近战 能量。

perkDetails.name: Icarus Dash
perkDetails.description:
[Air Dodge]  : Dodge quickly while airborne.

While Heat Rises is active, you have an additional dodge.

While airborne, rapidly defeating targets with your Super or weapons cures you.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
[空中闪身]  ：在空中时快速闪身。

炙热升腾激活时，拥有额外闪身。

在空中时，用你的超能或武器快速击败目标可治愈你。

items.name: Triple Jump
items.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时进行第二次或第三次跳跃可保持在空中。

items.name: Blink
items.description: Jump while airborne to teleport a short distance.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可触发一小段距离的传送。

items.name: High Jump
items.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时再次跳跃可上升到更高的高度。

items.name: Strafe Jump
items.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时凭借强劲的方向控制再次进行跳跃。

items.name: Thundercrash
items.description: Hurtle through the air like a missile and crash into targets to inflict meteoric damage.
items.descriptionZh: 像导弹一样飞速穿过空中并撞进目标群中，造成流星伤害。

items.name: Fists of Havoc
items.description:
Supercharge your fists and slam the ground with the force of a maelstrom. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Quickly dash forward, dealing damage to any impacted targets.

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your fists to the ground, blinding targets and dealing damage in an area around you, leaving aftershocks in your wake. Performing a slam from the air or after a dash deals additional damage.
items.descriptionZh:
对双拳进行超级充能，使用漩涡之力猛击地面。激活时：

[轻攻击]  ：快速向前冲刺，对任何被撞到的目标造成伤害。

[重攻击]  ：用双拳猛砸地面，致盲目标，对你周围造成伤害并产生余震。从空中砸向地面或冲刺后可造成额外伤害。

perkDetails.name: Facet of Blessing
perkDetails.description: Melee final blows start health regeneration. While transcendent, melee final blows start health regeneration for you and nearby allies.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 近战最后一击会带来生命值回复效果。处于超凡状态时，近战最后一击会为你和你附近的盟友带来生命值回复效果。

perkDetails.name: Facet of Command
perkDetails.description:
Freezing or suppressing a target reloads your equipped weapons and increases weapon stability, aim assist, and airborne effectiveness.

Defeating frozen or suppressed targets creates a Stasis Shard or Void Breach.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
冻结或压制目标会填装你已装备的武器并提升武器稳定性、瞄准辅助和空中效率。

击败被冻结或压制的目标会生成一个冰影碎片或虚空裂口。

perkDetails.name: Facet of Purpose
perkDetails.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants either Bolt Charge, Restoration, Frost Armor, Woven Mail, or Overshield based on the damage type of your equipped Super.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会基于你已装备超能的伤害类型，提供电光充能、恢复、冰霜护甲、织造铠甲或覆盖护盾。

perkDetails.name: -10 Class ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Class ▼

perkDetails.name: Facet of Ruin
perkDetails.description: Increases the size and damage of the burst when you shatter a Stasis crystal or frozen target, and increases the area of effect of Solar ignitions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你击碎一个冰影水晶或被冻结的目标时，提升爆发的规模和伤害，并扩大烈日点燃的效果范围。

perkDetails.name: +10 Weapon ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Weapon ▲

perkDetails.name: Facet of Mending
perkDetails.description: Grenade final blows cure you. Transcendence grenade final blows increase the strength of the effect.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 手雷最后一击会治愈你。超凡手雷最后一击可提升效果强度。

perkDetails.name: Facet of Honor
perkDetails.description: Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants Transcendence energy of the same type.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 收集元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会提供相同类型的超凡能量。

perkDetails.name: +10 Melee ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Melee ▲

perkDetails.name: Facet of Sacrifice
perkDetails.description: While you have an Arc, Solar, or Void buff, ability final blows grant bonus Darkness Transcendence energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拥有电弧、烈日或虚空增益时，技能最后一击会提供额外暗影超凡能量。

perkDetails.name: +10 Grenade ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Grenade ▲

perkDetails.name: Facet of Bravery
perkDetails.description: Defeating targets with grenade final blows grants Volatile Rounds to your [Void] Void weapons. Defeating targets with powered melee final blows grants Unraveling Rounds to your [Strand] Strand weapons.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用手雷最后一击击败目标会提供不稳定弹药给你的虚空武器。使用充能近战最后一击击败目标会提供瓦解弹药给你的缚丝武器。

perkDetails.name: Facet of Dominance
perkDetails.description: Your Void grenades weaken targets, and your Arc grenades jolt targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你的虚空手雷会削弱目标，而你的电弧手雷会震颤目标。

perkDetails.name: -10 Grenade ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Grenade ▼

perkDetails.name: Facet of Awakening
perkDetails.description: Rapidly defeating targets with Light or Darkness damage or Super final blows generates an Elemental pickup of the matching damage type.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用光能或暗影伤害或超能最后一击快速击败目标，会生成一个匹配该伤害类型的元素拾取物。

perkDetails.name: +10 Health ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Health ▲
perkDetails.descriptionZh: +10 生命值 ▲

items.name: Skip Grenade
items.description: A grenade that splits upon impact, creating multiple projectiles that seek targets.
items.descriptionZh: 命中时分裂产生多个射弹追击目标的手雷。

perkDetails.name: Trapper's Ambush
perkDetails.description:
Activate your air move to consume your class ability energy and dive to the ground, damaging targets on impact. Damage is greatly increased if striking while you have any Void status effect.

Damaging opponents with this ability heals you. Defeating combatants with this ability grants Devour.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活空中移动来消耗你的职业技能能量并朝地面俯冲，撞击目标时造成伤害。若你拥有任意虚空状态效果，撞击伤害将大幅提高。

使用此技能伤害对手会治疗你。使用此技能击败战斗人员会提供吞食。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perkDetails.name: Vanishing Step
perkDetails.description: Dodging makes you invisible.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 闪身可使你获得隐形效果。

perkDetails.name: Stylish Executioner
perkDetails.description:
Defeating a weakened, suppressed, or volatile target grants Invisibility and Truesight.

After performing a Stylish Execution, your next melee attack while invisible weakens targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
击败虚弱的、被压制的、或不稳定的目标可获得隐身和真视。

在完成一次潇洒处刑后，你下一次的隐身近战攻击会使目标虚弱。

perkDetails.name: On the Prowl
perkDetails.description:
Periodically marks a nearby combatant as a priority target for you and your team. Entering invisibility immediately marks a target.

Defeating priority targets creates a weakening cloud of smoke that makes you and allies invisible when passing through it. 

When priority targets are defeated, you and nearby allies gain increased weapon reload speed and stability for a short duration and are granted grenade, melee, and class ability energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
周期性将附近的一名战斗人员标记为你和你队伍的首要目标。进入隐形状态会立即标记一个目标。

击败首要目标会生成具有削弱效果的烟雾云，你和盟友穿过它时会获得隐身状态。

当首要目标被击败时，你和附近的盟友会在短时间内提升武器填装速度和稳定性，并获得手雷、近战和职业技能能量。

perkDetails.name: Weavewalk
perkDetails.description:
[Air Dodge]  : Dodge while airborne to consume your melee energy and enter the weave, gaining damage resistance from combatants and players. Reactivate your air dodge or cast your Rift to exit the weave, generating Woven Mail for you and nearby allies.

While in the weave, your melee energy is drained and you generate perched Threadlings over time. Threadling hits generate ability energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
[空中闪身]  ：在空中时闪身将消耗你的近战能量并进入编织状态，获得来自战斗人员和玩家的伤害抗性。重新激活空中闪身或投掷裂痕来退出编织，为你和附近盟友生成织造铠甲。

在编织状态中，你的近战能量会耗尽并会慢慢产生息停线虫。线虫命中会产生技能能量。

perkDetails.name: Weaver's Call
perkDetails.description:
Activate your class ability to weave three Threadlings and deploy any Threadlings you have perched.

Dealing damage and defeating targets generates perched Threadlings.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活你的职业技能来编织三条线虫并部署任何你已息停的线虫。

造成伤害和击败目标将产生息停线虫。

perkDetails.name: Mindspun Invocation
perkDetails.description:
Your grapple, Shackle Grenade, Threadling Grenade, and Slicewire Grenade have enhanced functionality.

Your grapple melee spawns three Threadlings.

[Grenade]  : Hold to consume your Shackle Grenade and activate Weaver's Trance. Final blows while Weaver's Trance is active create a suspending detonation.

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Threadling Grenade, causing it to weave a Threadling Nest at the impact location that repeatedly spawns Threadlings. 

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Slicewire Grenade. The grenade's final detonation will launch submunitions and leave a Tangle in its wake.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你的抓取、束缚手雷、线虫手雷和切线手雷拥有强化性能。

你的抓取近战会生成三个线虫。

[手雷]  ：按住消耗你的束缚手雷并激活编织者之境。编织者之境激活时造成最后一击可生成一次悬停爆炸。

[手雷]  ：按住以充能你的线虫手雷，使其在命中地点编织一个不断生成线虫的线虫巢穴。

[手雷]  ：按住以充能你的切线手雷。该手雷最终爆炸时将发射子弹药并在其路径上留下一个缠结。

perkDetails.name: The Wanderer
perkDetails.description:
Tangles you throw attach to targets and detonate into a suspending burst. Destroying a Tangle creates a suspending burst after a short delay.

Threadling final blows create Tangles or reduce your current Tangle cooldown.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你投掷的缠结会附着在目标身上，并引爆成一个悬停爆发。摧毁一个缠结会在短暂延迟后生成一个悬停爆发。

线虫最后一击会生成一个缠结或减少你当前的缠结冷却时间。

items.name: Catapult Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强大的初始爆发动量升到空中。

items.name: Strafe Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强劲的方向控制升到空中。

items.name: High Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并上升至更高的高度。

items.name: Electrified Snare
items.description: [Grenade]  : Throw an explosive device energized with [Strand] Strand matter and [Arc] Arc energy that detonates in a supercharged suspending burst. The suspended target takes heavy damage over time and chains jolting lightning to any nearby targets.
items.descriptionZh: [手雷]  ：投掷出一个由缚丝物质和电弧能量充能的易爆装置，引爆为超充的悬停爆发。被悬停的目标会受到大量持续伤害并将震颤闪电连锁传递到附近目标身上。

perkDetails.name: Ember of Torches
perkDetails.description: Powered melee attacks against combatants make you and nearby allies radiant.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对战斗人员进行的充能近战攻击可赋予你和附近友军焕光效果。

perkDetails.name: -10 Grenade ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Grenade ▼

perkDetails.name: Ember of Combustion
perkDetails.description: Final blows with a Solar Super causes targets to ignite and creates a Firesprite.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用烈日超能完成最后一击可对目标造成点燃效果并生成一个焰灵。

perkDetails.name: +10 Melee ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Melee ▲

perkDetails.name: Ember of Tempering
perkDetails.description:
Solar weapon final blows grant you and your allies increased health for a short duration. Stacks 3 times.

While Ember of Tempering is active, your weapons have increased airborne effectiveness, and your Solar weapon final blows create a Firesprite.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
烈日武器最后一击可让你和盟友在短时间内获得更高的生命值。可叠加3层。

激活回火余烬时，你的武器将拥有更高的空中效率，并且烈日武器最后一击可生成一个焰灵。

perkDetails.name: -10 Class ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Class ▼

perkDetails.name: Ember of Char
perkDetails.description: Your Solar ignitions spread scorch to affected targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你的烈日点燃可将灼烧效果蔓延至受影响的目标。

perkDetails.name: +10 Grenade ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Grenade ▲

perkDetails.name: Ember of Benevolence
perkDetails.description: Applying restoration, cure, or radiant to allies grants increased grenade, melee, and class ability regeneration for a short duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对盟友施加恢复、治愈或焕光效果可在短时间内提升手雷、近战和职业技能的回复能力。

perkDetails.name: -10 Grenade ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Grenade ▼

perkDetails.name: Ember of Singeing
perkDetails.description: Your class ability recharges faster when you scorch targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 灼烧目标时你的职业技能充能速度将加快。

perkDetails.name: Ember of Empyrean
perkDetails.description: Solar weapon or ability final blows extend the duration of restoration and radiant effects applied to you.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 烈日武器或技能最后一击可延长施加在自身的恢复和焕光效果的持续时间。

perkDetails.name: -10 Health ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Health ▼
perkDetails.descriptionZh: -10 生命值 ▼

perkDetails.name: Ember of Beams
perkDetails.description: Your Solar Super projectiles have stronger target acquisition.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你的烈日超能弹道将拥有更强的捕获能力。

perkDetails.name: +10 Super ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Super ▲

perkDetails.name: Ember of Solace
perkDetails.description: Radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 施加在自身的焕光和恢复效果拥有更长的持续时间。

perkDetails.name: Ember of Blistering
perkDetails.description: Defeating targets with Solar ignitions grants grenade energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用烈日点燃消灭目标可获得手雷能量。

items.name: Golden Gun: Marksman
items.description:
Summon a precision flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Your Golden Gun deals massively increased precision damage, overpenetrates targets, and creates Orbs of Power on precision hits.

Benefits from being radiant.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一把精准烈焰手枪，产生烈日之光灼烧并裂解目标。

你的黄金枪可造成大幅增加的精准伤害，穿透目标，并在精准命中时生成能量球。

可从焕光状态中获益。

items.name: Golden Gun: Deadshot
items.description:
Summon a rapid-fire flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Final blows with this weapon refund a Golden Gun round and extend your super duration.

Benefits from being radiant.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一把速射烈焰手枪，产生烈日之光灼烧并裂解目标。

使用此武器造成最后一击将返还一枚黄金枪弹药，并延长你的超能持续时间。

可从焕光状态中获益。

items.name: Blade Barrage
items.description: Vault into the air and unleash a volley of Solar-charged knives that explode and scorch targets.
items.descriptionZh: 跃向空中并释放一连串会爆炸并灼烧目标的烈日能量飞刀。

items.name: Healing Rift
items.description: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造能量源泉，为位于其中的角色提供持续治疗。

items.name: Empowering Rift
items.description:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
items.descriptionZh:
制造光能源泉，为位于其中的角色增加武器伤害和技能能量回复。

击败站在裂痕中的战斗人员可以获得额外弹药生成。

items.name: Marksman's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
items.descriptionZh: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

items.name: Gambler's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
items.descriptionZh: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

items.name: High Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并上升至更高的高度。

items.name: Strafe Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强劲的方向控制升到空中。

items.name: Catapult Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强大的初始爆发动量升到空中。

items.name: Towering Barricade
items.description: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造一道大型屏障，利用掩体巩固作战位置，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

items.name: Rally Barricade
items.description: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造一道小型屏障，瞄准时可透过屏障进行观察，你的武器的填装速度、稳定性和射程都会提高，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

items.name: Thruster
items.description: Quickly evade in a lateral direction.
items.descriptionZh: 迅速朝侧向躲避。

perkDetails.name: Whisper of Chains
perkDetails.description: Defeating targets while you have Frost Armor has a chance to create a [Stasis] Stasis shard.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拥有冰霜护甲时击败目标，有几率生成一块冰影碎片。

perkDetails.name: +10 Class ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Class ▲

perkDetails.name: Whisper of Torment
perkDetails.description: You gain grenade energy each time you take damage from targets. Having Frost Armor increases the amount of energy gained.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 每次受到目标的伤害时获得手雷能量。拥有冰霜护甲会获得更多的能量。

perkDetails.name: -10 Grenade ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Grenade ▼

perkDetails.name: Whisper of Fractures
perkDetails.description: Shattering a frozen target with a melee attack grants a stack of Frost Armor.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用近战攻击击碎一个被冻结的目标会赋予一层冰霜护甲。

perkDetails.name: Whisper of Impetus
perkDetails.description: Damaging targets with a [Stasis] Stasis melee reloads your weapons and grants you a temporary boost to weapon ready speed.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 用冰影近战对目标造成伤害会为你填装武器，并使你在短时间内获得武器准备速度加成。

perkDetails.name: +10 Health ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Health ▲
perkDetails.descriptionZh: +10 生命值 ▲

perkDetails.name: Cryoclasm
perkDetails.description: Shattering a frozen target spawns seekers that track and freeze other nearby targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击碎一个被冻结的目标会生成追踪弹，追踪并冻结附近的其他目标。

perkDetails.name: Frostpulse
perkDetails.description:
Casting your Rift generates a shockwave that freezes nearby targets, granting you Frost Armor when it does so.

Freezing combatants generates class ability energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
施放裂痕会产生震荡波，冻结附近的目标，如冻结目标则为你提供冰霜护甲。

冻结战斗人员会生成职业技能能量。

perkDetails.name: Weaver's Call
perkDetails.description:
Activate your class ability to weave three Threadlings and deploy any Threadlings you have perched.

Dealing damage and defeating targets generates perched Threadlings.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活你的职业技能来编织三条线虫并部署任何你已息停的线虫。

造成伤害和击败目标将产生息停线虫。

perkDetails.name: Lightning Surge
perkDetails.description: While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to blink forward, calling down lightning strikes that jolt targets as you rematerialize. This ability also makes you amplified and grants Bolt Charge.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 在滑铲时，启动你的已充能近战技能来向前瞬移，在重新物质化的同时降下闪电打击震颤目标。此技能还能让你获得增幅状态，并提供电光充能。

perkDetails.name: Bleak Watcher
perkDetails.description: [Grenade]  : Hold to convert your grenade into a [Stasis] Stasis turret that fires slowing projectiles at nearby targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: [手雷]  ：长按将你的手雷转换成一个冰影炮台，向附近的目标发射减速射弹。

perkDetails.name: Hellion
perkDetails.description:
Activate your class ability to summon a [Solar] Solar mortar that lobs flaming projectiles at distant targets. Targets damaged by the mortar are scorched.

Hellion damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
启动你的职业技能来召唤一个可向远处目标发射火焰射弹的烈日迫击炮。被迫击炮伤害的目标会被灼烧。

地狱火的伤害会根据手雷属性强化增益进行调整。

perkDetails.name: Feed the Void
perkDetails.description:
Defeat a target with any ability to activate Devour.

Your Devour effects are improved, restoring additional health and grenade energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用任意技能击败目标来启动吞食。

你的吞食效果获得改善，恢复额外生命值和手雷能量。

items.name: Hammer Strike
items.description:
After sprinting for a short time, use this melee ability to swing a blazing hammer that scorches your target and deals damage in a cone behind them.

If your target is defeated by Hammer Strike, they ignite.
items.descriptionZh:
短时间冲刺后，使用此近战技能挥出一支燃烧的战锤，灼烧目标并在其身后锥形区域造成伤害。

如果目标被战锤打击消灭，其将会被点燃。

items.name: Throwing Hammer
items.description: Throw a hammer from a distance. Picking up a thrown hammer grants melee energy. Energy generated is scaled by your Melee stat. If the hammer struck a target, picking it up grants cure.
items.descriptionZh: 从远处投掷飞锤。拾起飞锤会获得近战能量。生成的能量会根据你的近战属性进行调整。如果飞锤击中目标，拾起时可提供治愈效果。

items.name: Magnetic Grenade
items.description: A grenade that attaches to targets and explodes twice.
items.descriptionZh: 可粘附在目标身上并发生两次爆炸的手雷。

items.name: Burst Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以强大的初始爆发速度开始空中漂移。

items.name: Strafe Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并凭借强劲的方向控制开始空中漂移。

items.name: Balanced Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以适当的速度和方向控制开始空中漂移。

items.name: Glacier Grenade
items.description: A grenade that creates walls out of [Stasis] Stasis crystals to block damage and freeze targets; these walls can be shattered for damage.
items.descriptionZh: 手雷可制造出冰影水晶所形成的墙壁以阻挡伤害和冻结目标；可以碎裂这些墙壁来制造伤害。

perkDetails.name: Drengr's Lash
perkDetails.description:
Activate your Barricade ability to create a ripple in reality that travels forward along the ground, suspending and damaging the targets it hits.

Final blows on targets affected by Suspend, Unravel, or Sever grant class ability energy.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活屏障技能来在现实世界中生成一道沿着地面向前传播的涟漪，悬停击中的目标并对其造成伤害。

对受到悬停、瓦解或断舍影响的目标造成最后一击可获得职业技能能量。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perkDetails.name: Into the Fray
perkDetails.description:
Destroying a Tangle or casting your Super grants Woven Mail for nearby allies.

While you have Woven Mail, your melee regeneration rate is increased.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
摧毁缠结或施放超能会为附近盟友提供织造铠甲。

身穿织造铠甲时，你的近战恢复速率将提升。

perkDetails.name: Banner of War
perkDetails.description:
Defeat a target with a melee attack, finisher, or Sword to raise a Banner of War that pulses with energy, periodically healing nearby allies and increasing melee and Sword damage. 

Targets defeated by you and nearby allies charge the banner, increasing the speed of its pulses.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用近战攻击、终结技或刀剑击败目标来升起一面会发出能量脉冲的战旗，周期性治疗附近的盟友，并提升近战和刀剑伤害。

你和附近的盟友击败目标会给战旗充能，提高其脉冲的速度。

perkDetails.name: Flechette Storm
perkDetails.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to leap into the air, knocking nearby targets away and dealing damage.

While airborne, activate your charged melee again to launch a cluster of damaging, unraveling projectiles. Repeatedly activating melee will chain additional throws.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
滑行时，激活你的充能近战技能可跃向空中，击退附近目标并造成伤害。

在空中时，再次激活你的充能近战来发射一连串可造成伤害的瓦解射弹。重复激活近战技能将连锁额外投掷。

items.name: Hailfire Spike
items.description: [Grenade]  : Throw a device charged with [Stasis] Stasis matter and [Solar] Solar energy that attaches to surfaces or targets, then erupts into a slowing storm. After a short duration, the device ignites, creating a deadly scorching cyclone.
items.descriptionZh: [手雷]  ：投掷出一个由冰影物质和烈日能量充能的装置，附着在表面或目标上，然后爆发为减速风暴。一小段时间后，装置会点燃，产生致命的灼烧旋风。

items.name: Fusion Grenade
items.description: An explosive grenade that attaches to targets, damaging and moderately scorching them on detonation.
items.descriptionZh: 可粘附在目标身上的高爆手雷，爆炸时对其造成伤害及中等灼烧效果。

items.name: Vortex Grenade
items.description: A grenade that creates a Vortex that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
items.descriptionZh: 可产生涡流将目标吸入其中，对困在其中的目标造成持续性伤害的手雷。

items.name: Vortex Grenade
items.description: A grenade that creates a Vortex that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
items.descriptionZh: 可产生涡流将目标吸入其中，对困在其中的目标造成持续性伤害的手雷。

perkDetails.name: Ember of Eruption
perkDetails.description: Your Solar ignitions have increased area of effect.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你的烈日点燃范围效果获得提升。

perkDetails.name: +10 Melee ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Melee ▲

perkDetails.name: Ember of Ashes
perkDetails.description: You apply more scorch stacks to targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你可对目标施加更多灼烧层数。

perkDetails.name: Ember of Wonder
perkDetails.description: Rapidly defeating multiple targets with Solar ignitions generates an Orb of Power.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 通过烈日点燃快速消灭多个目标会生成能量球。

perkDetails.name: +10 Health ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Health ▲
perkDetails.descriptionZh: +10 生命值 ▲

perkDetails.name: Ember of Searing
perkDetails.description: Defeating scorched targets grants melee energy and creates a Firesprite.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击败灼烧的目标可获得近战能量并生成一个焰灵。

perkDetails.name: +10 Class ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Class ▲

items.name: Stormtrance
items.description:
Chain Arc Lightning from your hands to electrify targets with devastating streams of Arc Light that intensify over time. Casting Stormtrance creates a jolting shockwave underneath you.

[Sprint]  : Teleport forward, consuming a small amount of Super energy.
items.descriptionZh:
从你的手中释放电弧闪电，用极具破坏力且随着时间增强的电弧光能流来电击目标。施放雷霆万钧会在你脚下产成一道震颤冲击波。

[冲刺]  ：向前传送，消耗少量超能能量。

items.name: Chaos Reach
items.description:
Unleash a long-range channeled beam of concentrated Arc energy. Sustained damage on a single target creates a jolting lightning strike at their position.

 [Super]  while active to deactivate your Super early, saving Super energy.
items.descriptionZh:
释放一道由浓缩电弧能量组成的远距离引导光束。对单体目标造成持续伤害可在其位置生成一道震颤闪电打击。激活时

 [超能] 可以提前终止超能，保留部分超能能量。

items.name: Triple Jump
items.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时进行第二次或第三次跳跃可保持在空中。

items.name: High Jump
items.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时再次跳跃可上升到更高的高度。

items.name: Strafe Jump
items.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时凭借强劲的方向控制再次进行跳跃。

items.name: Phantom Surge
items.description:
Dash forward, slashing combatants as you pass through them. Deals significantly increased damage to Void-debuffed targets, or targets marked by On The Prowl.
 
Generate Void Overshield for each combatant hit. Defeating at least one combatant grants additional Overshield and refunds melee ability energy.
items.descriptionZh:
向前冲刺，穿过战斗人员时对其猛击。对受到虚空减益的目标或被伺机而动标记的目标造成显著提升的伤害。
 
每命中一名战斗人员都会生成虚空覆盖护盾。击败至少一名战斗人员提供额外覆盖护盾并返还近战技能能量。

items.name: Snare Bomb
items.description:
Throw a Smoke Bomb that attaches to surfaces and pings enemy radar, then detonates into a disorienting smoke cloud, weakening nearby targets. Targets within the smoke cloud take damage over time.

Upon deployment, makes nearby allies invisible.
items.descriptionZh:
投掷一个烟雾弹，它会附着在表面上，发信号给敌人的雷达，然后引爆为一团使人迷失方向的烟云，削弱附近的目标。烟云内的目标会受到持续伤害。

部署后，让附近的盟友隐身。

items.name: Transcendence
items.description:
Achieve harmony by dealing damage with Light and Dark damage types in equal measure or by applying subclass buffs to your allies. Kinetic damage generates both Light and Dark energy.

While Transcendence is active, your grenade is replaced by a unique Prismatic grenade that deals both Light and Dark damage. Dealing melee damage while transcendent greatly increases your grenade energy regeneration, and vice versa. Defeating targets while transcendent extends its duration.
items.descriptionZh:
通过等量使用光能与暗影伤害类型造成伤害或对你的盟友施加分支职业增益来实现和谐。动能伤害会同时生成光能与暗影能量。

当超凡状态生效时，你的手雷会被替换为同时造成光能与暗影伤害的独特棱镜手雷。处于超凡状态时，造成近战伤害会大幅提升手雷能量回复速度，反之亦然。处于超凡状态时，击败目标可延长其持续时间。

items.name: Grapple
items.description:
Weave a grappling hook, and quickly pull yourself forward. Grappling to a Tangle immediately recharges your grenade energy.

During and shortly after grappling, your melee attack deals area damage and unravels targets.
items.descriptionZh:
编织一个抓钩，将你自身快速向前拉动。抓取缠结会立即重新充能你的手雷能量。

在抓取期间及之后不久，你的近战攻击会造成范围伤害并瓦解目标。

items.name: Ball Lightning
items.description:
Fire an Arc projectile forward that releases a perpendicular lightning strike after a short time.

While amplified, Ball Lightning releases additional lightning strikes before detonating.
items.descriptionZh:
向前方发射出一枚电弧射弹，此弹短时间后会释放一次垂直闪电打击。

在增幅状态下，球形闪电会在爆炸前放出额外的闪电打击。

items.name: Chain Lightning
items.description:
An extended range melee that jolts your target and chains lightning to nearby targets.

While amplified, it creates an additional set of chains.
items.descriptionZh:
一种打击距离更远的近战，可震颤你的目标并向附近目标施放连锁闪电。

在增幅状态下，此技能会多放出一串连锁闪电。

items.name: Blink
items.description: Jump while airborne to teleport a short distance.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可触发一小段距离的传送。

items.name: Balanced Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以适当的速度和方向控制开始空中漂移。

items.name: Burst Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以强大的初始爆发速度开始空中漂移。

items.name: Strafe Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并凭借强劲的方向控制开始空中漂移。

items.name: Void Spike
items.description: A grenade that attaches to any surface and emits a torrent of damaging Void Light.
items.descriptionZh: 可吸附在任意表面并散发出连续不断的伤害性虚空之光的手雷。

perkDetails.name: Consecration
perkDetails.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to launch a wave of [Solar] Solar energy forward, damaging and scorching targets in front of you as you leap into the air.

While airborne, activate your charged melee again to slam to the ground and create a second larger wave of damaging [Solar] Solar energy. If the wave hits a scorched target, they ignite.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
滑行时，激活你的充能近战技能可向前发射一波烈日能量，跃向空中的同时对前方目标造成伤害和灼烧效果。

在空中时，再次激活你的充能近战技能可猛击地面，生成第二波更大的烈日伤害能量。如果能量波击中灼烧目标，则会将其点燃。

perkDetails.name: Unbreakable
perkDetails.description:
[Grenade]  : Hold to summon a [Void] Void shield that draws hostile fire and blocks a portion of incoming damage, gradually draining your grenade energy and granting an Overshield over time.

Releasing the grenade input or running out of energy releases a frontal blast from your shield that disorients combatants and deals increased damage based on how much damage was blocked. Final blows with the frontal blast grant you Devour.

Combatants that come in contact with your shield are temporarily disoriented.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
[手雷]  ：长按以召唤一个虚空护盾，它可吸引敌人火力并抵挡一部分伤害，逐渐消耗你的手雷能量并赋予一个覆盖护盾。

释放手雷键或耗尽能量时，你的护盾会释放出正面冲击波，它使战斗人员迷失方向，并基于已抵挡的伤害量造成更高的伤害。正面冲击波造成的最后一击会为你提供吞食。

接触到你护盾的战斗人员会暂时迷失方向。

perkDetails.name: Diamond Lance
perkDetails.description:
Shatter or defeat targets with abilities or [Stasis] Stasis weapons to create a Stasis lance.

[Shoot]  : Throw the lance to freeze targets on impact.

[Melee]  : Slam the lance to the ground to freeze targets in a small area.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用技能或冰影武器碎裂或击败目标来生成冰影长矛。

[射击]  ：投掷长矛以冻结被命中的目标。

[近战]  ：使用长矛猛击地面以冻结小范围内的目标。

perkDetails.name: Knockout
perkDetails.description:
Critically wounding a target or breaking their shield infuses your melee attacks with Arc energy and increases your melee range against combatants and melee damage against combatants and Guardians for a short time.

Defeating targets with melee attacks makes you amplified and restores a portion of your health. Defeating more powerful combatants increases the amount of health restored.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
重伤目标或打破其护盾可在短时间内给你的近战攻击赋予电弧能量，增加你对战斗人员的近战范围和对战斗人员及守护者的近战伤害。

用近战攻击打败目标会使你进入增幅状态，并恢复一部分生命值。击败强力战斗人员会恢复更多生命值。

perkDetails.name: Drengr's Lash
perkDetails.description:
Activate your Barricade ability to create a ripple in reality that travels forward along the ground, suspending and damaging the targets it hits.

Final blows on targets affected by Suspend, Unravel, or Sever grant class ability energy.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活屏障技能来在现实世界中生成一道沿着地面向前传播的涟漪，悬停击中的目标并对其造成伤害。

对受到悬停、瓦解或断舍影响的目标造成最后一击可获得职业技能能量。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perkDetails.name: Drengr's Lash
perkDetails.description:
Activate Thruster to create an unstable knot of [Strand] Strand matter that detonates after a short delay, suspending and damaging targets.

Final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs grant Thruster energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
启动推进器来生成一个不稳定的缚丝物质绳结，可在短暂延迟后引爆，悬停目标并对其造成伤害。

对受到元素减益影响的目标造成最后一击会提供悬停能量。

items.name: Gambler's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
items.descriptionZh: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

items.name: Marksman's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
items.descriptionZh: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

perkDetails.name: Ionic Sentry
perkDetails.description:
Defeat targets with Kinetic or Arc weapons or Arc abilities to charge up an Arc turret that periodically chains lightning between nearby targets, granting a stack of Bolt Charge with each hit.

[Grenade]  : Deploy the Ionic Sentry, blinding nearby targets on initial impact.

Ionic Sentry damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用动能或电弧武器或电弧技能击败目标来为电弧炮台充能，该炮台会将连锁闪电周期性地传递到附近目标身上，每次命中都会施加一层电光充能。

[手雷]  ：部署离子哨兵，初次命中可致盲附近目标。

离子哨兵的伤害会根据手雷属性强化增益进行调整。

perkDetails.name: Electrostatic Mind
perkDetails.description:
Defeating targets with Arc abilities or defeating jolted or blinded targets creates an Ionic Trace.

Collecting an Ionic Trace makes you amplified.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用电弧技能击败目标，或者击败被震颤或致盲的目标会产生一个离子轨迹。

收集离子轨迹会使你进入增幅状态。

perkDetails.name: Lightning Surge
perkDetails.description: While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to blink forward, calling down lightning strikes that jolt targets as you rematerialize. This ability also makes you amplified and grants Bolt Charge.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 在滑铲时，启动你的已充能近战技能来向前瞬移，在重新物质化的同时降下闪电打击震颤目标。此技能还能让你获得增幅状态，并提供电光充能。

perkDetails.name: Arc Soul
perkDetails.description:
Cast your Rift to create an Arc Soul that fires at targets in front of you. Allies can pass through your Rift to get an Arc Soul. Your Rift charges faster when allies are near.

While amplified, your Arc Souls are supercharged and gain increased fire rate.

Arc Soul damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
施放你的裂痕以产生一个能射击你前方目标的电弧之魂。盟友可以穿过你的裂痕来获得一个电弧之魂。附近有盟友时你的裂痕充能更快。

在增幅状态下，你的电弧之魂会获得超级充能，射速更快。

电弧之魂的伤害会根据手雷属性强化增益进行调整。

items.name: Pulse Grenade
items.description: A grenade that periodically damages targets within its explosion radius.
items.descriptionZh: 能够对位于其爆炸范围内的目标造成周期性伤害的手雷。

items.name: Freezing Singularity
items.description: [Grenade]  : Throw a mass of [Void] Void energy and [Stasis] Stasis matter. On impact, deploys a miniature black hole orbited by a slowing field. After a short duration, the black hole implodes, suppressing and dealing heavy damage to all nearby targets.
items.descriptionZh: [手雷]  ：投掷出大量虚空能量和冰影物质。命中时，部署一个被减速力场环绕的微型黑洞。一小段时间后，黑洞会内爆，压制所有附近目标并对其造成大量伤害。

items.name: Withering Blade
items.description:
Toss a [Stasis] Stasis Shuriken at targets to damage and slow them.  

Provides multiple charges.
items.descriptionZh:
向目标投掷一枚冰影手里剑，伤害并减速目标。 

可多次使用。

items.name: Slicewire Grenade
items.description: A grenade that bounces and releases multiple whirling threads, severing targets.
items.descriptionZh: 一种会弹跳并释放多条旋转丝线的手雷，可割裂目标。

items.name: Catapult Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强大的初始爆发动量升到空中。

items.name: High Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并上升至更高的高度。

items.name: Strafe Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强劲的方向控制升到空中。

items.name: Transcendence
items.description:
Achieve harmony by dealing damage with Light and Dark damage types in equal measure or by applying subclass buffs to your allies. Kinetic damage generates both Light and Dark energy.

While Transcendence is active, your grenade is replaced by a unique Prismatic grenade that deals both Light and Dark damage. Dealing melee damage while transcendent greatly increases your grenade energy regeneration, and vice versa. Defeating targets while transcendent extends its duration.
items.descriptionZh:
通过等量使用光能与暗影伤害类型造成伤害或对你的盟友施加分支职业增益来实现和谐。动能伤害会同时生成光能与暗影能量。

当超凡状态生效时，你的手雷会被替换为同时造成光能与暗影伤害的独特棱镜手雷。处于超凡状态时，造成近战伤害会大幅提升手雷能量回复速度，反之亦然。处于超凡状态时，击败目标可延长其持续时间。

items.name: Phoenix Dive
items.description: Dive to the ground and create a burst of Solar Light that cures nearby allies.
items.descriptionZh: 向地面俯冲并生成一束可治愈附近盟友的烈日光能。

items.name: Healing Rift
items.description: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造能量源泉，为位于其中的角色提供持续治疗。

items.name: Empowering Rift
items.description:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
items.descriptionZh:
制造光能源泉，为位于其中的角色增加武器伤害和技能能量回复。

击败站在裂痕中的战斗人员可以获得额外弹药生成。

items.name: Incinerator Snap
items.description: Snap your fingers to create a fan of burning sparks that explode and scorch targets.
items.descriptionZh: 打响手指生成一个燃烧火扇，可爆炸并灼烧目标。

items.name: Celestial Fire
items.description: Send out a spiral of three explosive Solar energy blasts, scorching targets with each hit.
items.descriptionZh: 发射一道螺旋的三个爆炸性烈日能量飞弹，每次击中都会灼烧目标。

items.name: Scatter Grenade
items.description: A grenade that splits into many submunitions and covers a large area with multiple explosions.
items.descriptionZh: 可分裂出大量子弹药并造成可覆盖大片区域的多次爆炸的手雷。

items.name: Shackle Grenade
items.description: A thrown weapon of weighted Strand matter that detonates on impact, suspending targets and creating additional suspending subprojectiles.
items.descriptionZh: 一种投掷武器，由加重的缚丝物质组成，会在击中时爆炸，悬停目标并生成额外的悬停子射弹。

items.name: Magnetic Grenade
items.description: A grenade that attaches to targets and explodes twice.
items.descriptionZh: 可粘附在目标身上并发生两次爆炸的手雷。

perkDetails.name: Howl of the Storm
perkDetails.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to launch a wave of [Stasis] Stasis energy forward that freezes enemy combatants, slows enemy players, and creates [Stasis] Stasis crystals.

Grants an additional melee charge.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
滑行时激活你的充能近战技能会向前发射一道冰影能量波，冻结地方战斗人员，减速敌方玩家，并产生冰影水晶。

提供额外的近战充能。

items.name: Arcbolt Grenade
items.description: A grenade that chains bolts of lightning to nearby targets.
items.descriptionZh: 在附近目标之间引起连锁闪电的手雷。

items.name: Blink
items.description: Jump while airborne to teleport a short distance.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可触发一小段距离的传送。

items.name: Triple Jump
items.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时进行第二次或第三次跳跃可保持在空中。

items.name: Strafe Jump
items.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时凭借强劲的方向控制再次进行跳跃。

items.name: High Jump
items.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时再次跳跃可上升到更高的高度。

perkDetails.name: Controlled Demolition
perkDetails.description: Hitting a target with a Void ability or Volatile explosion makes them volatile. Further damage to a volatile target causes them to explode. Grants you and nearby allies health when volatile targets explode near you.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用虚空技能或不稳定爆炸击中目标会使其不稳定。对不稳定的目标造成进一步的伤害会使其爆炸。不稳定的目标在你附近爆炸时向你和附近的盟友提供生命值。

perkDetails.name: Bastion
perkDetails.description:
Cast your Super to grant Overshield to nearby allies. 

Casting your Barricade grants Overshield to yourself and nearby allies and empowers it, enabling it to slowly regenerate the Overshield of allies bunkering behind it and extend their Overshield duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
施放超能来赋予附近盟友覆盖护盾。

施放屏障可赋予自己和附近盟友覆盖护盾，并为其赋能，使其缓慢恢复躲在后面的盟友的覆盖护盾，并延长他们的覆盖护盾持续时间。

perkDetails.name: Offensive Bulwark
perkDetails.description:
While you have an Overshield or are inside Ward of Dawn, final blows grant grenade and melee energy, you have increased melee range and damage, and melee final blows restore a small portion of your Overshield and extend its duration.

You gain an additional Shield Throw while in Sentinel Shield.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
拥有覆盖护盾或位于黎明护罩内时，进行最后一击提供手雷与近战能量，你的近战距离和伤害获得提升，近战最后一击可恢复小部分覆盖护盾并延长其持续时间。

在哨兵圣盾中时可进行一次额外的圣盾投掷。

perkDetails.name: Unbreakable
perkDetails.description:
[Grenade]  : Hold to summon a [Void] Void shield that draws hostile fire and blocks a portion of incoming damage, gradually draining your grenade energy and granting an Overshield over time.

Releasing the grenade input or running out of energy releases a frontal blast from your shield that disorients combatants and deals increased damage based on how much damage was blocked. Final blows with the frontal blast grant you Devour.

Combatants that come in contact with your shield are temporarily disoriented.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
[手雷]  ：长按以召唤一个虚空护盾，它可吸引敌人火力并抵挡一部分伤害，逐渐消耗你的手雷能量并赋予一个覆盖护盾。

释放手雷键或耗尽能量时，你的护盾会释放出正面冲击波，它使战斗人员迷失方向，并基于已抵挡的伤害量造成更高的伤害。正面冲击波造成的最后一击会为你提供吞食。

接触到你护盾的战斗人员会暂时迷失方向。

items.name: Nova Warp
items.description:
Step between dimensions to subvert the laws of physics.

[Super Secondary]  : Teleport a short distance and release weakening seekers.

[Super Primary]  : Unleash a deadly Void eruption. A fully charged attack makes targets volatile.
items.descriptionZh:
穿梭于位面之间以颠覆物理定律。

[超能附技能]  ：传送一小段距离并放出削弱追踪弹。

[超能主技能]  ：释放一次致命虚空爆发。完全充能的攻击可对目标施加不稳定效果。

items.name: Nova Bomb: Vortex
items.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb creates a singularity that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
items.descriptionZh:
向目标抛出可发生爆炸的虚空光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

新星炸弹可产生一个奇点，将目标拉入其中，并对困在其中的敌人造成持续性伤害。

items.name: Nova Bomb: Cataclysm
items.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks targets. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles.
items.descriptionZh:
向目标抛出虚空光能爆炸光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

新星炸弹会缓慢移动并追踪目标。发生爆炸时会碎裂成较小的追踪性射弹。

perkDetails.name: Touch of Thunder
perkDetails.description:
Your Flashbang, Pulse, Lightning, and Storm Grenades have enhanced functionality.

Flashbang Grenade: Emits an additional blinding detonation on bounce.

Pulse Grenade: Creates Ionic Traces periodically as it damages targets and increases in damage over time.

Lightning Grenade: Grants an additional grenade charge, jolts targets hit by the initial blast, and grants Bolt Charge when it causes damage.

Storm Grenade: After detonating, creates a roaming thundercloud that tracks nearby targets and fires bolts of lightning at foes beneath it.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你的闪光、脉冲、闪电以及风暴手雷有更强的效果。

闪光手雷：反弹时额外发射一次致盲爆炸。

脉冲手雷：对目标造成伤害时周期性产生离子轨迹并逐渐提高伤害。

闪电手雷：赋予一枚额外的手雷并震颤初次爆破命中的目标，并且在造成伤害时提供电光充能。

风暴手雷：在爆炸后，制造一团会追踪附近目标并朝下方敌人释放闪电的移动雷云。

perkDetails.name: Juggernaut
perkDetails.description:
With full class ability energy and after sprinting for a short time, you gain a frontal shield that blocks incoming damage. When the frontal shield breaks, your class ability energy is depleted. When the frontal shield takes damage, you gain a stack of Bolt Charge.

While amplified, the shield blocks significantly more damage before breaking.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
在职业技能能量已满并短时间冲刺后，你会得到一面抵挡来袭伤害的正面护盾。在护盾被打破后，你会耗尽所有职业技能能量。当正面护盾受到伤害时，你会获得一层电光充能。

在增幅状态下，护盾可抵挡的伤害显著增加。

perkDetails.name: Knockout
perkDetails.description:
Critically wounding a target or breaking their shield infuses your melee attacks with Arc energy and increases your melee range against combatants and melee damage against combatants and Guardians for a short time.

Defeating targets with melee attacks makes you amplified and restores a portion of your health. Defeating more powerful combatants increases the amount of health restored.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
重伤目标或打破其护盾可在短时间内给你的近战攻击赋予电弧能量，增加你对战斗人员的近战范围和对战斗人员及守护者的近战伤害。

用近战攻击打败目标会使你进入增幅状态，并恢复一部分生命值。击败强力战斗人员会恢复更多生命值。

perkDetails.name: Storm's Keep
perkDetails.description:
Cast your class ability to grant a moderate amount of Bolt Charge stacks to you and nearby allies.

While behind your Barricade, you and allies gain stacks of Bolt Charge over time and your weapons can discharge max stacks of Bolt Charge.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
施放你的职业技能，为你和附近的盟友提供适量的电光充能层数。

当你位于屏障后面时，你和盟友会随着时间推移获得电光充能层数，并且你的武器可以释放最大层数的电光充能。

items.name: Threaded Spike
items.description: Throw a rope dart that bounces between targets, damaging and severing them. The dart will return to you once it's done, returning melee energy to you for each target hit. Press [Melee] just as the dart gets back to you to catch it and increase the amount of energy returned.
items.descriptionZh: 扔出一枚在目标之间回弹的绳镖，对目标造成伤害并将其割裂。绳镖在完成攻击后会回到手上，且每次命中目标都会返还一定量的近战能量。在绳镖即将回到手上时按[近战]来接住它，可以增加返还的能量。

items.name: Catapult Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强大的初始爆发动量升到空中。

items.name: High Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并上升至更高的高度。

items.name: Strafe Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强劲的方向控制升到空中。

items.name: Pulse Grenade
items.description: A grenade that periodically damages targets within its explosion radius.
items.descriptionZh: 能够对位于其爆炸范围内的目标造成周期性伤害的手雷。

perkDetails.name: Spark of Focus
perkDetails.description: After sprinting for a short time, your class ability regeneration is increased.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 进行冲刺后短时间内，你的职业技能回复会增加。

perkDetails.name: Spark of Frequency
perkDetails.description:
Melee hits increase your equipped weapon's reload speed and stability for a short duration.

While amplified, the effects are increased and you gain increased stacks of Bolt Charge from all sources.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
近战命中会在短时间内提升你已装备武器的填装速度和稳定性。

处于增幅状态时，效果获得提升，并且你会从所有来源获得更多电光充能层数。

perkDetails.name: Spark of Discharge
perkDetails.description:
Arc weapon final blows have a chance to create an Ionic Trace.

Collecting an Ionic Trace grants you a stack of Bolt Charge.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
电弧武器最后一击有几率生成一个离子轨迹。

收集一个离子轨迹会为你提供一层电光充能。

perkDetails.name: -10 Melee ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Melee ▼

perkDetails.name: Spark of Ions
perkDetails.description: Defeating a jolted target or defeating a target with Bolt Charge creates an Ionic Trace.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击败被震颤的目标或带有电光充能的目标会生成一个离子轨迹。

perkDetails.name: Spark of Shock
perkDetails.description: Your Arc grenades jolt targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你的电弧手雷会震颤目标。

perkDetails.name: -10 Grenade ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Grenade ▼

perkDetails.name: Spark of Momentum
perkDetails.description: Sliding over ammo bricks reloads your equipped weapon and grants you a small amount of Bolt Charge.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 滑行经过弹药盒会填装你当前装备的武器，并为你提供少量电光充能。

perkDetails.name: Spark of Resistance
perkDetails.description: While surrounded by combatants, you are more resistant to incoming damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 在被战斗人员包围时，你对伤害的抗性增加。

perkDetails.name: +10 Melee ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Melee ▲

perkDetails.name: Spark of Beacons
perkDetails.description: While you are amplified, your Arc Special or Heavy ammo weapon final blows create a blinding explosion.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 处于增幅状态时，你的电弧特殊或重型弹药武器最后一击会造成一个致盲爆炸。

perkDetails.name: Spark of Magnitude
perkDetails.description: Your lingering Arc grenades (Lightning Grenade, Pulse Grenade, and Storm Grenade) have extended duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你的持久电弧手雷（闪电手雷、脉冲手雷、风暴手雷）的持续时间加长。

perkDetails.name: Spark of Recharge
perkDetails.description: While critically wounded, your melee and grenade energy regenerates more quickly.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 身受重伤时，你的近战和手雷能量回复速度会加快。

items.name: Healing Grenade
items.description: A grenade that cures allies on impact and creates an Orb of benevolent Solar Light, granting restoration to allies when picked up.
items.descriptionZh: 可在击中时治疗友军并制造仁慈烈日光能能量球的手雷，拾取能量球时可为友军提供恢复效果。

items.name: Needlestorm
items.description:
[Super]  : Conjure a hail of deadly woven needles.

After embedding themselves in the environment, the needles will re-weave into a host of Threadlings.

Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets. Damaging targets with your weapons or melee will send out perched Threadlings to attack.
items.descriptionZh:
[超能]  ：召唤一阵致命织针风暴。

这些织针融入环境后，会重新编织成大量线虫。

如果你生成的这些线虫无法找到任何附近目标，它们会返回你的位置并息停。使用你的武器或近战对目标造成伤害会派出息停的线虫发动攻击。

items.name: Nova Bomb: Cataclysm
items.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks targets. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles.
items.descriptionZh:
向目标抛出虚空光能爆炸光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

新星炸弹会缓慢移动并追踪目标。发生爆炸时会碎裂成较小的追踪性射弹。

items.name: Song of Flame
items.description:
Unleash your inner fire, making your equipped weapons radiant and enhancing your abilities.

[Melee]  : Release a supercharged melee attack that launches additional projectiles.

[Grenade]  : Create a sentient flame wisp that seeks out targets and detonates in a scorching explosion, then seeks out other nearby targets.

While Song of Flame is active, you and nearby allies regenerate abilities more quickly, are more resistant to incoming damage, and your [Solar] Solar and Kinetic weapons scorch targets.
items.descriptionZh:
释放你的内心炽焰，让你装备的武器进入焕光状态并强化你的技能。

[近战]  ：释放一记发射额外射弹的超级充能近战攻击。

[手雷]  ：创造一股灵性的烈焰火苗，自动追踪目标并造成一次灼烧爆炸，然后追踪附近的其他目标。

在烈焰之歌生效时，你和附近的盟友技能回复更快，且对伤害的抗性增加。你的烈日和动能武器会灼烧目标。

items.name: Winter's Wrath
items.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis staff. While your Super is active:

[Super Primary]  : Cast out a barrage of [Stasis] Stasis shards that freeze targets.

[Super Secondary]  : Cast out a shockwave that shatters all frozen targets.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一根冰影法杖。当超能激活时：

[超能主技能] ：施放由冰影碎片组成的弹幕，冻结敌人。

[超能附技能] ：施放一个震荡波，粉碎所有被冻结的敌人。

items.name: Stormtrance
items.description:
Chain Arc Lightning from your hands to electrify targets with devastating streams of Arc Light that intensify over time. Casting Stormtrance creates a jolting shockwave underneath you.

[Sprint]  : Teleport forward, consuming a small amount of Super energy.
items.descriptionZh:
从你的手中释放电弧闪电，用极具破坏力且随着时间增强的电弧光能流来电击目标。施放雷霆万钧会在你脚下产成一道震颤冲击波。

[冲刺]  ：向前传送，消耗少量超能能量。

items.name: Needlestorm
items.description:

After embedding themselves in the environment, the needles will re-weave into a host of Threadlings.

Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets. Damaging targets with your weapons or melee will send out perched Threadlings to attack.

这些织针融入环境后，会重新编织成大量线虫。

perkDetails.name: Grim Harvest
perkDetails.description:
Picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards grants stacks of Frost Armor.

While you have Frost Armor, defeating combatants with Stasis or Kinetic weapons may cause them to shatter, damaging nearby foes. The shatter chance increases with your Frost Armor stacks.

Taking damage while you have Frost Armor generates class ability energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
拾取冰影碎片会获得冰霜护甲层数。

拥有冰霜护甲时，用冰影或动能武器击败战斗人员可能会使其碎裂，对附近敌人造成伤害。碎裂几率根据你的冰霜护甲层数而增加。

拥有冰霜护甲时受到伤害会生成职业技能能量。

items.name: Shield Throw
items.description: Hurl your Void Shield toward a target. The shield can ricochet off targets and surfaces, granting Overshield for each target hit.
items.descriptionZh: 向目标投掷你的虚空护盾。盾牌可在目标和表面弹射，每击中一个目标都会赋予覆盖护盾。

items.name: Shiver Strike
items.description: Hold input to leap through the air. Releasing unleashes a powerful dash attack that knocks targets back and attaches a delayed Stasis explosive to them.
items.descriptionZh: 长按以飞跃到空中。松开后施放一次强力的冲刺攻击，击退目标，并在目标身上粘附一个延迟冰影炸药。

items.name: Hammer Strike
items.description:
After sprinting for a short time, use this melee ability to swing a blazing hammer that scorches your target and deals damage in a cone behind them.

If your target is defeated by Hammer Strike, they ignite.
items.descriptionZh:
短时间冲刺后，使用此近战技能挥出一支燃烧的战锤，灼烧目标并在其身后锥形区域造成伤害。

如果目标被战锤打击消灭，其将会被点燃。

items.name: Thunderclap
items.description:
[Melee] : Hold while grounded to plant your feet and begin charging your fist with Arc energy.

[Melee] : Release to unleash a devastating blast in front of you, dealing damage that increases with longer charge time.
items.descriptionZh:
[近战]：在地面上时按住此键以站稳脚跟并开始在手中充能电弧能量。

[近战]：放开此键以向前方释放出一道毁灭性的冲击波。充能越久，伤害越大。

items.name: Frenzied Blade
items.description: Activate your charged melee ability to dash forward, slashing at targets in front of you and severing them.
items.descriptionZh: 激活你的充能近战技能向前猛冲，猛击你面前的目标并割裂他们。

items.name: Glacial Quake
items.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis gauntlet. While your Super is active:

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your gauntlet down to create a shockwave that freezes targets and sends out [Stasis] Stasis crystals to freeze additional ones.

[Light Attack]  : Supercharge your Shiver Strike for bonus damage. Sprint through [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets to shatter them instantly.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一个冰影臂铠。当超能激活时：

[重攻击] ：用臂铠猛击地面，制造一次震荡波，冻结目标并射出冰影水晶来冻结其他敌人。

[轻攻击] ：对你的战栗打击进行超级充能以获得伤害加成。冲刺穿过冰影水晶或被冻结的目标会立即将其粉碎。

items.name: Shiver Strike
items.description: Hold input to leap through the air. Releasing unleashes a powerful dash attack that knocks targets back and attaches a delayed Stasis explosive to them.
items.descriptionZh: 长按以飞跃到空中。松开后施放一次强力的冲刺攻击，击退目标，并在目标身上粘附一个延迟冰影炸药。

perkDetails.name: Tectonic Harvest
perkDetails.description:
Picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards grants stacks of Frost Armor.

While you have Frost Armor, defeating combatants with Stasis or Kinetic weapons may cause them to shatter, damaging other nearby combatants. The shatter chance increases with your Frost Armor stacks.

Taking damage while you have Frost Armor generates melee energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
拾取冰影碎片会获得冰霜护甲层数。

拥有冰霜护甲时，用冰影或动能武器击败战斗人员可能会使其碎裂，对附近其他战斗人员造成伤害。碎裂几率根据你的冰霜护甲层数而增加。

拥有冰霜护甲时受到伤害会生成近战能量。

perkDetails.name: Cryoclasm
perkDetails.description: Your slide distance is greatly increased. Sliding releases a wave that shatters [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets on contact, along with any other frozen targets nearby.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 大幅增加你的滑行距离。滑行时释放一道冲击波，接触时击碎  冰影水晶或被冻结的目标，以及附近其他被冻结的目标。

items.name: Rally Barricade
items.description: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造一道小型屏障，瞄准时可透过屏障进行观察，你的武器的填装速度、稳定性和射程都会提高，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

items.name: Towering Barricade
items.description: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造一道大型屏障，利用掩体巩固作战位置，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

items.name: Firebolt Grenade
items.description: A grenade that unleashes bolts of damaging Solar Light at nearby targets and slightly scorches them.
items.descriptionZh: 能够对附近目标释放伤害性烈日光束，并对其造成轻微灼烧效果的手雷。

items.name: Empowering Rift
items.description:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
items.descriptionZh:
制造光能源泉，为位于其中的角色增加武器伤害和技能能量回复。

击败站在裂痕中的战斗人员可以获得额外弹药生成。

items.name: Healing Rift
items.description: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造能量源泉，为位于其中的角色提供持续治疗。

items.name: Solar Grenade
items.description: A grenade that creates a flare of Solar Light that continuously damages and scorches targets trapped inside.
items.descriptionZh: 可迸发出烈日之光的手雷，对困在其中的目标造成持续性伤害及灼烧效果。

items.name: High Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并上升至更高的高度。

items.name: Strafe Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强劲的方向控制升到空中。

items.name: Catapult Lift
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强大的初始爆发动量升到空中。

items.name: Suppressor Grenade
items.description: An explosive grenade that suppresses, preventing targets from using abilities for a short time.
items.descriptionZh: 一种能造成 压制效果的高爆手雷，可以使目标在短时间内无法使用 技能。

perkDetails.name: Echo of Dilation
perkDetails.description: While crouched, you sneak faster and gain enhanced radar resolution.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 蹲下时，你的潜行速度更快并获得增强雷达分辨率。

perkDetails.name: +10 Weapon ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Weapon ▲

perkDetails.name: +10 Super ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Super ▲

perkDetails.name: Echo of Domineering
perkDetails.description:
After suppressing a target, you gain increased weapon stat for a short duration, and your equipped weapon is reloaded from reserves.

Defeating suppressed targets creates a Void Breach.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
压制目标后，你的武器属性会在短时间内提升，并用储存弹药填装当前装备的武器。

击败被压制的目标会生成一个虚空裂口。

perkDetails.name: +10 Grenade ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Grenade ▲

perkDetails.name: Echo of Provision
perkDetails.description: Damaging targets with grenades grants melee energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用手雷对目标造成伤害可回复近战能量。

perkDetails.name: +10 Grenade ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Grenade ▲

perkDetails.name: Echo of Expulsion
perkDetails.description: Void ability final blows cause targets to explode.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 虚空技能最后一击将造成目标爆炸。

perkDetails.name: +10 Super ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Super ▲

perkDetails.name: Echo of Remnants
perkDetails.description: Your lingering grenade effects (Vortex Grenade, Void Wall, Void Spike, and Axion Bolt) have increased duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 来自你的手雷的残留效果（涡流手雷，虚空墙壁，虚空尖刺，量子光束）的持续时间延长。

perkDetails.name: Echo of Exchange
perkDetails.description: Melee final blows grant grenade energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 近战最后一击将赋予手雷能量。

perkDetails.name: +10 Melee ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Melee ▲

perkDetails.name: Echo of Undermining
perkDetails.description: Your Void grenades weaken targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你的虚空手雷会削弱目标。

perkDetails.name: -10 Grenade ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Grenade ▼

perkDetails.name: Echo of Reprisal
perkDetails.description: Final blows when surrounded by combatants grant Super energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 被战斗人员包围时的最后一击将赋予超能能量。

perkDetails.name: Echo of Leeching
perkDetails.description: Melee final blows start health regeneration for you and nearby allies.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 近战最后一击会为你和你附近的友军带来生命恢复效果。

perkDetails.name: +10 Health ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Health ▲
perkDetails.descriptionZh: +10 生命值 ▲

perkDetails.name: Echo of Persistence
perkDetails.description: Void buffs applied to you (Invisibility, Overshield, and Devour) have increased duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你获得的虚空增益（隐身，覆盖护盾，吞食）的持续时间延长。

items.description:
Unleash your inner fire, making your equipped weapons radiant and enhancing your abilities.

[Melee]  : Release a supercharged melee attack that launches additional projectiles.

[Grenade]  : Create a sentient flame wisp that seeks out targets and detonates in a scorching explosion, then seeks out other nearby targets.

While Song of Flame is active, you and nearby allies regenerate abilities more quickly, are more resistant to incoming damage, and your [Solar] Solar and Kinetic weapons scorch targets.
