items.name: Daybreak
items.description:
Fashion Solar Light into blades and smite your foes from the sky.

Your Daybreak projectiles scorch targets on impact.
items.descriptionZh:
将烈日之光化作利刃，从空中轰击敌人。

你的黎明射弹在命中时会灼烧目标。

items.name: Well of Radiance
items.description: Thrust your Sword into the ground, damaging and scorching nearby targets. The sword projects a continuous aura, granting radiant effects and restoration to nearby allies, protecting them from the effects of Stasis.
items.descriptionZh: 将你的刀剑刺入地面，对附近目标造成伤害和灼烧效果。刀剑会发出持续的光环，为附近盟友提供焕光和恢复效果，使其免受冰影效果的影响。

items.name: Pocket Singularity
items.description:
Launch an unstable ball of Void energy that detonates when it nears a target, pushing them away from the blast and making them volatile.  

Provides multiple charges.
items.descriptionZh:
发射一个不稳定的球形虚空能量，在靠近目标的时候引爆，将目标从爆炸中心推开，并使其变得不稳定。

可多次使用。

items.name: Arcane Needle
items.description: Sling a woven needle that will embed in your target, unraveling them. Activate your melee ability again to chain up to two additional attacks.
items.descriptionZh: 抛甩一根织针插入你的目标，瓦解他们。再次激活你的近战技能，连锁最多两次额外攻击。

perkDetails.name: Feed the Void
perkDetails.description:
Defeat a target with a Void ability to activate Devour.

Your Devour effects are improved, restoring additional health and grenade energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用虚空技能击败目标来启动吞食。

你的吞食效果获得改善，恢复额外生命值和手雷能量。

perkDetails.name: Chaos Accelerant
perkDetails.description:
[Grenade]  : Overcharge your grenade, making it deadlier and more effective.

Vortex Grenade: Increases the size, linger duration, and pull of the vortex.

Axion Bolt: Detonates twice and has enhanced seekers.

Scatter Grenade: Submunitions track to nearby targets.

Magnetic Grenade, Spike Grenade, Voidwall Grenade, and Suppressor Grenade: Releases a short-range Void blast. Cooldown is reduced.

Grants an additional grenade charge.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
[手雷]  ：对手雷进行过充，使其更加致命有效。

涡流手雷：提升漩涡的大小、持续时间和和拉力。

量子光束：引爆两次，拥有强化追踪弹。

散射手雷：子弹药可追踪附近目标。

磁性手雷、尖刺榴弹、虚空之墙手雷和抑制手雷：释放短程的虚空爆破。冷却时间减少。

提供额外手雷充能。

perkDetails.name: Soul Siphon
perkDetails.description:
Ready this aspect by striking a foe with your powered melee ability.

Once readied, press your melee ability to begin siphoning energy from all combatants in front of you, dealing damage and gathering Overshield and class ability energy from each target.

Soul Siphon's damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Melee stat.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用充能近战技能打击敌人来准备此星相。

就绪后，按下近战技能，开始从你面前所有战斗人员身上汲取能量，造成伤害并从每个目标身上获取覆盖护盾和职业技能能量。

灵魂虹吸的伤害会根据近战属性强化收益而调整。

perkDetails.name: Child of the Old Gods
perkDetails.description:
Cast your rift to create a Void Soul. When you damage a target with a weapon, your Void Soul flies to them and drains them, doing damage and weakening them. Combatants affected by the Soul are also briefly suppressed.

When a target is being drained, you are granted grenade and melee energy (if running Healing Rift) or health (if running Empowering Rift).

Defeating a target who is being drained by your Void Soul grants class ability energy.

The Void Soul's damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
施放你的裂痕来制造一个虚空灵魂。使用武器对目标造成伤害时，你的虚空之魂会飞向他们并进行汲取，造成伤害并削弱他们。受灵魂影响的战斗人员还会被短暂压制。

目标被汲取时，你将获得手雷和近战能量（如果使用治愈裂痕）或生命值（如果使用强能裂痕）。

击败正被虚空灵魂汲取的目标可提供职业技能能量。

虚空灵魂的伤害会根据手雷属性强化增益进行调整。

perkDetails.name: Whisper of Reversal
perkDetails.description: While you have Frost Armor, melee damage slows your target.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拥有冰霜护甲时，近战伤害可减速你的目标。

perkDetails.name: Whisper of Chill
perkDetails.description: [Stasis] Stasis weapon final blows have a chance to create a Stasis Shard.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 冰影武器最后一击有几率生成一个冰影碎片。

items.name: Silkstrike
items.description:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.
items.descriptionZh:
编织出一根毒辣的绳镖，刺穿你的目标。

[轻攻击]  ：向前方投掷绳镖以造成伤害。绳镖尖会造成额外伤害，用镖尖击败目标会使其爆炸。

[重攻击]  ：以圆周运动挥动绳镖，对周围一切造成重创。

[手雷]  ：使用抓钩来迅速向前移动。

items.name: Storm's Edge
items.description:
Summon an electrified dagger and throw it in your aim direction.

When the dagger hits a surface or a target, you blink to its location and perform a powerful whirling strike, damaging any nearby targets. Can be reactivated after the strike to perform additional throws.

If the dagger flies for long enough without impacting anything, it detonates and you blink to the detonation location.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一把透电匕首，朝瞄准的方向投出。

当匕首命中某个表面或目标时，你会瞬移至其位置并施展强力旋风打击，对任何附近目标造成伤害。打击后可重新激活施展额外投掷。

匕首在未命中任何对象的情况下飞行足够远的距离后会引爆，而你将会瞬移至引爆位置。

items.name: Shadowshot: Deadfall
items.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.
items.descriptionZh:
将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，为你和友军大幅削弱和压制他们。

暗影箭矢所发射的虚空之锚会将敌人拉向命中位置，随后变成陷阱静候猎物的到来。虚空之锚射程与持续时间均增加。

items.name: Golden Gun: Marksman
items.description:
Summon a precision flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Your Golden Gun deals massively increased precision damage, overpenetrates targets, and creates Orbs of Power on precision hits.

Benefits from being radiant.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一把精准烈焰手枪，产生烈日之光灼烧并裂解目标。

你的黄金枪可造成大幅增加的精准伤害，穿透目标，并在精准命中时生成能量球。

可从焕光状态中获益。

items.name: Silence and Squall
items.description:
Summon two Stasis kamas, Silence and Squall, that you throw one after another.

Silence : Creates a flash-freeze blast that freezes and damages targets.

Squall : Creates a Stasis Storm that slows and damages targets caught inside.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤两把冰影镰刃：“沉默”与“狂啸”，并接连掷出。

沉默：制造一场急速冰冻爆炸，冰冻并伤害目标。

狂啸：制造一场冰影风暴以减速和伤害被包裹的目标。

items.name: Thermite Grenade
items.description: A grenade that sends forth a burning line of fire, dealing damage and scorching targets in its path.
items.descriptionZh: 能向前发射一道燃烧火焰的手雷，对路径上的目标造成伤害及灼烧效果。

items.name: Silkstrike
items.description:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.
items.descriptionZh:
编织出一根毒辣的绳镖，刺穿你的目标。

[轻攻击]  ：向前方投掷绳镖以造成伤害。绳镖尖会造成额外伤害，用镖尖击败目标会使其爆炸。

[重攻击]  ：以圆周运动挥动绳镖，对周围一切造成重创。

[手雷]  ：使用抓钩来迅速向前移动。

items.name: Grapple
items.description:
Weave a grappling hook, and quickly pull yourself forward. Grappling to a Tangle immediately recharges your grenade energy.

During and shortly after grappling, your melee attack deals area damage and unravels targets.
items.descriptionZh:
编织一个抓钩，将你自身快速向前拉动。抓取缠结会立即重新充能你的手雷能量。

在抓取期间及之后不久，你的近战攻击会造成范围伤害并瓦解目标。

items.name: Storm Grenade
items.description: A grenade that calls down a focused lightning storm.
items.descriptionZh: 能够引起一场集中的闪电风暴的手雷。

perkDetails.name: Whisper of Rending
perkDetails.description: Primary ammo weapons do increased damage to [Stasis] Stasis crystals and frozen targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 主弹药武器对冰影水晶以及被冻结的目标造成更多伤害。

perkDetails.name: Whisper of Conduction
perkDetails.description: Nearby [Stasis] Stasis shards track to your position.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 附近的冰影碎片会追踪至你的位置。

perkDetails.name: +10 Super ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Super ▲

perkDetails.name: +10 Health ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Health ▲
perkDetails.descriptionZh: +10 生命值 ▲

perkDetails.name: Whisper of Rime
perkDetails.description: Your Frost Armor has increased duration and maximum stack count.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你的冰霜护甲拥有更久的持续时间和最大层数。

perkDetails.name: Whisper of Hunger
perkDetails.description: Increases the melee energy gained from picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 增加拾取冰影碎片时得到的近战能量。

perkDetails.name: -20 Melee ▼
perkDetails.description: -20 Melee ▼

items.name: Towering Barricade
items.description: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造一道大型屏障，利用掩体巩固作战位置，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

items.name: Rally Barricade
items.description: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造一道小型屏障，瞄准时可透过屏障进行观察，你的武器的填装速度、稳定性和射程都会提高，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

items.name: Bladefury
items.description:
[Super]  : Create two woven blades and roam the battlefield. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Perform a leaping slash towards nearby targets, severing them on hit and dealing bonus damage to suspended targets. Each successful hit briefly increases your attack speed and grants energy for your heavy attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Unleash a heavy upward slash, creating two suspending projectiles that seek out targets.
items.descriptionZh:
[超能]  ：生成两把编织利刃掠过战场。激活时：

[轻攻击]  ：对附近的目标进行跃动砍击，击中时割裂他们并对悬停的目标造成额外伤害。每次成功击中可短暂提升你的攻击速度并为你的重攻击提供能量。

[重攻击]  ：发动一次上行重砍击，生成两枚可搜寻目标的悬停射弹。

items.name: Thundercrash
items.description: Hurtle through the air like a missile and crash into targets to inflict meteoric damage.
items.descriptionZh: 像导弹一样飞速穿过空中并撞进目标群中，造成流星伤害。

items.name: Glacial Quake
items.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis gauntlet. While your Super is active:

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your gauntlet down to create a shockwave that freezes targets and sends out [Stasis] Stasis crystals to freeze additional ones.

[Light Attack]  : Supercharge your Shiver Strike for bonus damage. Sprint through [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets to shatter them instantly.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一个冰影臂铠。当超能激活时：

[重攻击] ：用臂铠猛击地面，制造一次震荡波，冻结目标并射出冰影水晶来冻结其他敌人。

[轻攻击] ：对你的战栗打击进行超级充能以获得伤害加成。冲刺穿过冰影水晶或被冻结的目标会立即将其粉碎。

items.name: Twilight Arsenal
items.description:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.
items.descriptionZh:
[超能]  ：召唤三把虚空战斧并依次将其扔向敌人。命中时，战斧会拉近附近的目标，然后造成具有削弱效果的爆炸。爆炸后，战斧可以被你或盟友拾起，在短时间内作为武器使用。

携带一把虚空战斧时：
[轻攻击]  ：向前挥斩，造成伤害并削弱目标。
[重攻击]  ：投掷战斧，耗尽战斧的剩余弹药。

items.name: Hammer of Sol
items.description:
Summon a flaming hammer and wreak destruction down upon your enemies.

[Light Attack]  : Throw your hammer at foes.

Upon impact, your hammers shatter into explosive molten shards.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一把燃烧的战锤对你的敌人造成毁灭打击。

[轻攻击]  ：向敌人投掷战锤。

击中时，战锤会碎裂成爆炸熔合碎片。

items.name: Penumbral Blast
items.description: Raise your [Stasis] Stasis staff against your foe. Send a blast of [Stasis] Stasis forward to freeze your targets.
items.descriptionZh: 举起你的冰影法杖来对抗你的敌人。向前射出一道冰影冲击，冻结你的目标。

items.name: Incendiary Grenade
items.description: A grenade that explodes in a fiery burst and heavily scorches nearby targets.
items.descriptionZh: 可燃焰爆裂并对附近目标造成严重灼烧效果的手雷。

items.name: Silence and Squall
items.description:
Summon two Stasis kamas, Silence and Squall, that you throw one after another.

Silence : Creates a flash-freeze blast that freezes and damages targets.

Squall : Creates a Stasis Storm that slows and damages targets caught inside.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤两把冰影镰刃：“沉默”与“狂啸”，并接连掷出。

沉默：制造一场急速冰冻爆炸，冰冻并伤害目标。

狂啸：制造一场冰影风暴以减速和伤害被包裹的目标。

perkDetails.name: Facet of Balance
perkDetails.description: Rapidly defeating targets with Light damage grants melee energy. Rapidly defeating targets with Darkness damage grants grenade energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用光能伤害快速击败目标会提供近战能量。使用暗影伤害快速击败目标会提供手雷能量。

perkDetails.name: Facet of Justice
perkDetails.description: While transcendent, your ability final blows explode.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 处于超凡状态时，你的技能最后一击会造成爆炸。

perkDetails.name: +10 Super ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Super ▲

perkDetails.name: Facet of Protection
perkDetails.description: While surrounded by combatants, you are more resistant to incoming damage. While transcendent, the effect is increased.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 在被战斗人员包围时，你对伤害的抗性增加。处于超凡状态时，效果提升。

perkDetails.name: +10 Melee ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Melee ▲

perkDetails.name: Facet of Grace
perkDetails.description: Defeating targets with Kinetic weapons grants you bonus Transcendence energy. Defeating targets with your Super grants you and nearby allies bonus Transcendence energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用动能武器击败目标会为你提供额外超凡能量。使用超能击败目标会为你和附近盟友提供额外超凡能量。

perkDetails.name: -10 Health ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Health ▼
perkDetails.descriptionZh: -10 生命值 ▼

perkDetails.name: Facet of Hope
perkDetails.description: While you have an elemental buff, your class ability regenerates more quickly.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拥有元素增益时，你的职业技能回复速度更快。

perkDetails.name: Facet of Solitude
perkDetails.description: Landing rapid precision hits emits a severing blast from the target. While transcendent, the severing blast is bigger.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 造成快速精准命中会从目标身上爆发出割裂爆炸。处于超凡状态时，割裂爆炸威力更大。

perkDetails.name: Facet of Courage
perkDetails.description: Your [Arc] Arc, [Solar] Solar, and [Void] Void abilities deal increased damage to targets afflicted with Darkness debuffs.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你的电弧、烈日和虚空技能会对受到暗影减益效果影响的目标造成更多伤害。

perkDetails.name: +10 Grenade ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Grenade ▲

perkDetails.name: Facet of Devotion
perkDetails.description: Defeating targets afflicted with [Stasis] Stasis or [Strand] Strand debuffs grants bonus Light Transcendence energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击败受到冰影或缚丝减益效果影响的目标会提供额外光能超凡能量。

perkDetails.name: +10 Melee ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Melee ▲

perkDetails.name: Facet of Dawn
perkDetails.description: Powered melee hits against targets makes you radiant. Powered melee final blows make you and nearby allies radiant.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 充能近战命中目标会赋予你焕光效果。充能近战最后一击会赋予你和附近盟友焕光效果。

perkDetails.name: -10 Melee ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Melee ▼

perkDetails.name: Facet of Generosity
perkDetails.description: Defeating targets while transcendent creates Orbs of Power for your allies.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 处于超凡状态时击败目标，会为盟友生成能量球。

items.name: Strafe Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并凭借强劲的方向控制开始空中漂移。

items.name: Burst Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以强大的初始爆发速度开始空中漂移。

items.name: Balanced Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以适当的速度和方向控制开始空中漂移。

perkDetails.name: Bleak Watcher
perkDetails.description: [Grenade]  : Hold to convert your grenade into a [Stasis] Stasis turret that fires slowing projectiles at nearby targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: [手雷]  ：长按将你的手雷转换成一个冰影炮台，向附近的目标发射减速射弹。

perkDetails.name: Glacial Harvest
perkDetails.description:
Picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards grants stacks of Frost Armor.

While you have Frost Armor, defeating combatants with Stasis or Kinetic weapons may cause them to shatter, damaging other nearby foes. The shatter chance increases with your Frost Armor stacks.

Taking damage while you have Frost Armor generates grenade energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
拾取冰影碎片会获得冰霜护甲层数。

拥有冰霜护甲时，用冰影或动能武器击败战斗人员可能会使其碎裂，对附近其他敌人造成伤害。碎裂几率根据你的冰霜护甲层数而增加。

拥有冰霜护甲时受到伤害会生成手雷能量。

items.name: Threaded Spike
items.description: Throw a rope dart that bounces between targets, damaging and severing them. The dart will return to you once it's done, returning melee energy to you for each target hit. Press [Melee] just as the dart gets back to you to catch it and increase the amount of energy returned.
items.descriptionZh: 扔出一枚在目标之间回弹的绳镖，对目标造成伤害并将其割裂。绳镖在完成攻击后会回到手上，且每次命中目标都会返还一定量的近战能量。在绳镖即将回到手上时按[近战]来接住它，可以增加返还的能量。

items.name: Knife Trick
items.description: Throw a fan of flaming knives that scorch targets on hit.
items.descriptionZh: 投掷烈火刀扇， 灼烧 命中的目标。

items.name: Combination Blow
items.description:
A quick strike that temporarily increases your melee damage when defeating a target, stacking three times.

Defeating targets with this, grants class ability energy and restores a small amount of health. Energy gain is scaled by your Class stat.
items.descriptionZh:
一种在击败一个目标后可暂时增加近战伤害的快速打击技能，效果最多可叠加三次。

使用此技能击败目标会提供职业技能能量，并恢复少量生命值。获得的能量会根据你的职业属性调整。

items.name: Withering Blade
items.description:
Toss a [Stasis] Stasis Shuriken at targets to damage and slow them.  

Provides multiple charges.
items.descriptionZh:
向目标投掷一枚冰影手里剑，伤害并减速目标。 

可多次使用。

items.name: Snare Bomb
items.description:
Throw a Smoke Bomb that attaches to surfaces and pings enemy radar, then detonates into a disorienting smoke cloud, weakening nearby targets. Targets within the smoke cloud take damage over time.

Upon deployment, makes nearby allies invisible.
items.descriptionZh:
投掷一个烟雾弹，它会附着在表面上，发信号给敌人的雷达，然后引爆为一团使人迷失方向的烟云，削弱附近的目标。烟云内的目标会受到持续伤害。

部署后，让附近的盟友隐身。

perkDetails.name: Echo of Instability
perkDetails.description: Defeating targets with grenades grants Volatile Rounds to your Void weapons.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用手雷击败目标可给你的虚空武器装上不稳定弹药。

perkDetails.name: +10 Melee ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Melee ▲

perkDetails.name: Echo of Harvest
perkDetails.description: Defeating weakened targets creates an Orb of Power and a Void Breach.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击败虚弱的目标会生成一个能量球以及一个虚空裂口。

perkDetails.name: Echo of Obscurity
perkDetails.description: Finisher final blows grant Invisibility.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 终结技最后一击将赋予隐身。

perkDetails.name: +10 Class ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Class ▲

perkDetails.name: Echo of Starvation
perkDetails.description: Picking up a Void Breach or an Orb of Power grants Devour.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取虚空裂口或能量球会赋予吞食。

perkDetails.name: -10 Class ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Class ▼

items.name: Ballistic Slam
items.description:
After sprinting and while airborne, activate your charged melee ability to slam to the ground, dealing damage to nearby targets.

Gain Super energy and stacks of Bolt Charge based on number of targets hit by Ballistic Slam.
items.descriptionZh:
在冲刺之后或是在空中时激活你的充能近战技能来砸向地面，对附近的目标造成伤害。

基于弹道猛击命中的目标数量获得超能能量和电光充能层数。

items.name: Seismic Strike
items.description:
After sprinting for a short time, activate your charged melee ability to slam shoulder-first into your target, damaging and blinding targets in an area around them.

While you are amplified, the blind radius is increased.
items.descriptionZh:
进行冲刺后短时间内，激活充能近战技能用肩部冲撞目标，伤害并致盲其周围的目标。

在增幅状态下，致盲的范围更大。

items.name: Thunderclap
items.description:
[Melee] : Hold while grounded to plant your feet and begin charging your fist with Arc energy.

[Melee] : Release to unleash a devastating blast in front of you, dealing damage that increases with longer charge time.
items.descriptionZh:
[近战]：在地面上时按住此键以站稳脚跟并开始在手中充能电弧能量。

[近战]：放开此键以向前方释放出一道毁灭性的冲击波。充能越久，伤害越大。

items.name: Gambler's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
items.descriptionZh: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

items.name: Marksman's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
items.descriptionZh: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

items.name: Acrobat's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform an acrobatic leap. Upon landing, make yourself and nearby allies radiant.
items.descriptionZh: 闪身以施展一次特技之跃。着陆时，使自身和附近友军获得焕光效果。

items.name: Disorienting Blow
items.description: Striking a target with this melee ability blinds them, amplifies you, and grants you a moderate amount of Bolt Charge.
items.descriptionZh: 用此近战技能击中目标可对其施加致盲，使你进入增幅状态，并为你提供中量电光充能。

items.name: Combination Blow
items.description:
A quick strike that temporarily increases your melee damage when defeating a target, stacking three times.

Defeating targets with this, grants class ability energy and restores a small amount of health. Energy gain is scaled by your Class stat.
items.descriptionZh:
一种在击败一个目标后可暂时增加近战伤害的快速打击技能，效果最多可叠加三次。

使用此技能击败目标会提供职业技能能量，并恢复少量生命值。获得的能量会根据你的职业属性调整。

items.name: Shadowshot: Moebius Quiver
items.nameZh: 暗影箭矢：莫比乌斯箭袋
items.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

Fire two volleys of three Void Arrows that seek nearby targets. Shadowshot makes targets volatile and deals increased damage to tethered targets. Defeating tethered targets creates Orbs of Power.

While the Super is active, dealing damage increases the damage of your Void Arrows and Bow weapons.
items.descriptionZh:
将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，为你和盟友大幅削弱和压制他们。

发射两组三发虚空箭矢，搜寻附近目标。暗影箭矢会使敌人变得不稳定，对已被束缚的目标造成更高伤害。击败被束缚的目标会生成能量球。

在超能启用期间，造成伤害会提升你的虚空箭矢和弓箭武器伤害。

items.name: Spectral Blades
items.description:
Summon a pair of deadly Void blades and stalk the battlefield in a veil of shadows.

[Light Attack]  : Perform a quick melee attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Perform a heavy attack that weakens your target, and once again vanish from sight.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一对致命的虚空利刃，然后在暗影笼罩之下潜入战场。

 [轻攻击] ：进行一次快速的近战攻击。

 [重攻击] ：进行一次可削弱目标的重攻击，并再次从敌人的视野中消失。

items.name: Shadowshot: Deadfall
items.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.
items.descriptionZh:
将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，为你和友军大幅削弱和压制他们。

暗影箭矢所发射的虚空之锚会将敌人拉向命中位置，随后变成陷阱静候猎物的到来。虚空之锚射程与持续时间均增加。

items.name: Towering Barricade
items.description: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造一道大型屏障，利用掩体巩固作战位置，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

items.name: Rally Barricade
items.description: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造一道小型屏障，瞄准时可透过屏障进行观察，你的武器的填装速度、稳定性和射程都会提高，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

items.name: Burning Maul
items.description:
Summon a flaming maul and crush targets with the force of an earthquake.

[Light Attack]  : Spin the maul in a circle around you, damaging nearby targets.

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam the maul to the ground and create a cyclone of flames that seeks targets, dealing damage and scorching them.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一支燃烧的大锤，用地震的力量碾碎目标。

[轻攻击]  ：在自身周围旋转大锤，对附近目标造成伤害。

[重攻击]  ：朝地面猛击大锤并制造出一股追踪目标的火焰旋风，造成伤害并灼烧他们。

items.name: Hammer of Sol
items.description:
Summon a flaming hammer and wreak destruction down upon your enemies.

[Light Attack]  : Throw your hammer at foes.

Upon impact, your hammers shatter into explosive molten shards.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一把燃烧的战锤对你的敌人造成毁灭打击。

[轻攻击]  ：向敌人投掷战锤。

击中时，战锤会碎裂成爆炸熔合碎片。

items.name: Void Wall
items.description: A grenade that creates a horizontal wall of burning Void Light.
items.descriptionZh: 可产生一堵燃烧着虚空之光的横向墙壁的手雷。

items.name: Shackle Grenade
items.description: A thrown weapon of weighted Strand matter that detonates on impact, suspending targets and creating additional suspending subprojectiles.
items.descriptionZh: 一种投掷武器，由加重的缚丝物质组成，会在击中时爆炸，悬停目标并生成额外的悬停子射弹。

items.name: Marksman's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
items.descriptionZh: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

items.name: Gambler's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
items.descriptionZh: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

perkDetails.name: Threaded Specter
perkDetails.description:
Activating your class ability leaves behind a decoy woven from [Strand] Strand matter that draws the attention of nearby combatants.

After taking significant damage or when combatants approach, the decoy detonates, dealing damage and releasing Threadlings that seek out and attack nearby foes.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活你的职业技能将留下一个由缚丝物质编织的诱饵，吸引附近战斗人员的注意。

在受到高额伤害或战斗人员接近时，诱饵会自动引爆，造成伤害并释放出能追寻并攻击附近敌人的线虫。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perkDetails.name: Stylish Executioner
perkDetails.description:
Defeating a target affected by any elemental debuff grants invisibility and Truesight.

After performing a Stylish Execution, your next melee attack while invisible weakens targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
击败受到任何元素减益效果影响的目标可获得隐身和真视。

在完成一次潇洒处刑后，你下一次的隐身近战攻击会使目标虚弱。

perkDetails.name: Ascension
perkDetails.description:
[Air Move]  While airborne, consume your class ability energy to summon your Arc Staff, propelling yourself upward and creating a burst of energy around you that amplifies allies and jolts targets.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
[空中移动]  在空中时，消耗你的职业技能能量来召唤电弧法杖，推动自身向上并在四周生成增幅盟友和震颤目标的能量爆发。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perkDetails.name: Winter's Shroud
perkDetails.description:
Dodging slows nearby targets.

Slowing targets briefly increases your class ability regeneration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
闪身会减速附近的目标。

减速目标会短暂增加你的职业技能回复。

perkDetails.name: Gunpowder Gamble
perkDetails.description:
Defeat targets to charge up an improvised [Solar] Solar explosive.

[Grenade]  : Throw a [Solar] Solar explosive that can be shot in mid-air to cause an ignition.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
击败目标可充能临时烈日爆炸。

[手雷]：投掷出可在半空被击中，造成点燃的烈日爆炸。

items.name: Swarm Grenade
items.description: A grenade that detonates on impact, releasing multiple drones that seek nearby targets. Each drone slightly scorches affected targets.
items.descriptionZh: 命中时会发生爆炸的手雷，可释放出多个无人机追踪附近目标。每个无人机可对受影响的目标造成轻微的灼烧效果。

items.name: Rally Barricade

items.name: Thruster
items.description: Quickly evade in a lateral direction.
items.descriptionZh: 迅速朝侧向躲避。

items.name: Flashbang Grenade
items.description: An explosive grenade that damages and blinds nearby targets.
items.descriptionZh: 可伤害并致盲附近目标的高爆手雷。

perkDetails.name: Shatterdive
perkDetails.description: Activate while midair to quickly descend and shatter nearby targets on impact. Shattering targets grants you Frost Armor.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 在半空中激活可快速下落并在撞击地面时碎裂附近的目标。碎裂目标可为你提供冰霜护甲。

perkDetails.name: Winter's Shroud
perkDetails.description:
Dodging slows nearby targets.

Slowing targets briefly increases your class ability regeneration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
闪身会减速附近的目标。

减速目标会短暂增加你的职业技能回复。

items.name: Tripmine Grenade
items.description: An explosive grenade that sticks to surfaces and detonates when targets pass through its laser trigger, dealing damage and moderately scorching them.
items.descriptionZh: 可粘附在表面上的高爆手雷，在目标穿过它的激光触发装置时引爆，对其造成伤害及中等灼烧效果。

items.name: Phoenix Dive
items.description:
Dive to the ground and create a burst of Solar Light that cures nearby allies.

While Heat Rises is active, you gain restoration while diving and scorch targets upon landing.
items.descriptionZh:
向地面俯冲并生成一束可治愈附近友军的烈日光能。

激活炙热升腾时，你可以在俯冲时获得恢复效果并在落地时灼烧敌人。

items.name: Empowering Rift
items.description:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
items.descriptionZh:
制造光能源泉，为位于其中的角色增加武器伤害和技能能量回复。

击败站在裂痕中的战斗人员可以获得额外弹药生成。

items.name: Healing Rift
items.description: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
items.descriptionZh: 制造能量源泉，为位于其中的角色提供持续治疗。

perkDetails.name: Roaring Flames
perkDetails.description: Final blows with [Solar] Solar abilities or ignitions increase the damage of your Solar abilities. Stacks 3 times.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用烈日技能或点燃完成最后一击可提高烈日技能的伤害。可叠加3层。

perkDetails.name: Sol Invictus
perkDetails.description:
Solar ability final blows, Hammer of Sol impacts, and defeating scorched targets creates Sunspots. Your abilities regenerate faster, and your Super drains more slowly while standing in a Sunspot.

Sunspots apply scorch and deal damage to targets inside. Entering a Sunspot applies restoration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
烈日技能最后一击、烈焰战锤击中以及消灭灼烧目标可生成太阳黑子。站在太阳黑子中时你的技能恢复速度将加快，超能消耗速度将减缓。

太阳黑子可对其内部的目标施加灼烧效果并造成伤害。进入太阳黑子可施加恢复效果。

perkDetails.name: Consecration
perkDetails.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to launch a wave of [Solar] Solar energy forward, damaging and scorching targets in front of you as you leap into the air.

While airborne, activate your charged melee again to slam to the ground and create a second larger wave of damaging [Solar] Solar energy. If the wave hits a scorched target, they ignite.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
滑行时，激活你的充能近战技能可向前发射一波烈日能量，跃向空中的同时对前方目标造成伤害和灼烧效果。

在空中时，再次激活你的充能近战技能可猛击地面，生成第二波更大的烈日伤害能量。如果能量波击中灼烧目标，则会将其点燃。

perkDetails.name: Shieldburst
perkDetails.description:
Enhances your equipped barricade with [Solar] Solar capabilities.

Towering Barricade: Your barricade slides forward across the ground before stopping, allowing you to advance in safety.

Rally Barricade: Standing behind your barricade grants scorching rounds to your allies' Solar and Kinetic weapons.

While your barricade is deployed, activate your class ability again to remotely detonate it, scorching combatants caught in the detonation. Dealing damage increases the power of the blast.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
为你当前装备的屏障提供烈日能力强化。

巍峨屏障：你的屏障会在地面上向前滑行后再停下，让你能够安全推进。

集结屏障：站在你的屏障后时，为盟友的烈日和动能武器提供灼烧弹。

在你的屏障部署期间，再次激活职业技能会远程引爆它，灼烧爆炸范围内的战斗人员。造成伤害会提升爆炸威力。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

items.name: Lightning Grenade
items.description: A grenade that sticks to any surface and emits bolts of lightning.
items.descriptionZh: 可粘附在任何表面上且发散闪电光束的手雷。

items.name: Healing Grenade
items.description: A grenade that cures allies on impact and creates an Orb of benevolent Solar Light, granting restoration to allies when picked up.
items.descriptionZh: 可在击中时治疗友军并制造仁慈烈日光能能量球的手雷，拾取能量球时可为友军提供恢复效果。

perkDetails.name: Gunpowder Gamble
perkDetails.description:
Defeat targets to charge up an improvised Solar explosive.

[Grenade]  : Throw a Solar explosive that can be shot in mid-air to cause an ignition.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
击败目标可充能临时烈日爆炸。

[手雷]  ：投掷出可在半空被击中，造成点燃的烈日爆炸。

perkDetails.name: Crackshot
perkDetails.description:
Activate your class ability to fire up to three scorching shots at combatants you've marked. Aim at targets to mark them.

Landing all three shots cures you.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活职业技能来向你标记的战斗人员发射至多三发灼烧射击。瞄准目标来标记他们。

三发全中会治愈你。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perkDetails.name: Knock 'Em Down
perkDetails.description:
Your Solar Supers are enhanced. Deadshot Golden Gun has damage resistance, Marksman Golden Gun has increased duration, and Blade Barrage launches more projectiles.

While radiant, final blows with your equipped Throwing Knife fully refund your melee energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你的烈日超能已得到强化。死亡射击黄金枪获得伤害抗性，神枪手黄金枪持续时间延长，利刃弹幕可发射更多射弹。

拥有焕光效果时，使用已装备的投掷飞刀造成最后一击可完全补偿近战能量。

perkDetails.name: On Your Mark
perkDetails.description:
Activating your class ability or landing precision hits grants you and nearby allies increased reload speed and Weapons stat for a short duration. Stacks ten times.

Final blows while at ten stacks cure you.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活职业技能或造成精准命中可让你和附近盟友在短时间内提升填装速度和武器属性。可叠加十次。

达到十层时造成最后一击将治愈你。

perkDetails.description: Super final blows emit a suspending burst from the target.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 超能最后一击会从目标身上爆发出悬停脉冲。

perkDetails.descriptionZh: 在受重伤时，受到伤害会使你爆发出一股能造成伤害并震颤目标的电弧能量。

items.descriptionZh: 在空中时进行第二次或第三次跳跃可保持在空中。

items.name: High Jump
items.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时再次跳跃可上升到更高的高度。

items.name: Strafe Jump

items.descriptionZh: 在空中时凭借强劲的方向控制再次进行跳跃。

items.name: Bladefury
items.description:
[Super]  : Create two woven blades and roam the battlefield. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Perform a leaping slash towards nearby targets, severing them on hit and dealing bonus damage to suspended targets. Each successful hit briefly increases your attack speed and grants energy for your heavy attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Unleash a heavy upward slash, creating two suspending projectiles that seek out targets.
items.descriptionZh:
[超能]  ：生成两把编织利刃掠过战场。激活时：

[轻攻击]  ：对附近的目标进行跃动砍击，击中时割裂他们并对悬停的目标造成额外伤害。每次成功击中可短暂提升你的攻击速度并为你的重攻击提供能量。

[重攻击]  ：发动一次上行重砍击，生成两枚可搜寻目标的悬停射弹。

items.name: Acrobat's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform an acrobatic leap. Upon landing, make yourself and nearby allies radiant.
items.descriptionZh: 闪身以施展一次特技之跃。着陆时，使自身和附近友军获得焕光效果。

items.name: Marksman's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
items.descriptionZh: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

items.name: Gambler's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
items.descriptionZh: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

items.name: Penumbral Blast
items.description: Raise your [Stasis] Stasis staff against your foe. Send a blast of [Stasis] Stasis forward to freeze your targets.
items.descriptionZh: 举起你的冰影法杖来对抗你的敌人。向前射出一道冰影冲击，冻结你的目标。

items.name: Chain Lightning
items.description:
An extended range melee that jolts your target and chains lightning to nearby targets.

While amplified, it creates an additional set of chains.
items.descriptionZh:
一种打击距离更远的近战，可震颤你的目标并向附近目标施放连锁闪电。

在增幅状态下，此技能会多放出一串连锁闪电。

items.name: Incinerator Snap
items.description: Snap your fingers to create a fan of burning sparks that explode and scorch targets.
items.descriptionZh: 打响手指生成一个燃烧火扇，可爆炸并灼烧目标。

items.name: Pocket Singularity
items.description:
Launch an unstable ball of Void energy that detonates when it nears a target, pushing them away from the blast and making them volatile.  

Provides multiple charges.
items.descriptionZh:
发射一个不稳定的球形虚空能量，在靠近目标的时候引爆，将目标从爆炸中心推开，并使其变得不稳定。

可多次使用。

items.name: Arcane Needle
items.description: Sling a woven needle that will embed in your target, unraveling them. Activate your melee ability again to chain up to two additional attacks.
items.descriptionZh: 抛甩一根织针插入你的目标，瓦解他们。再次激活你的近战技能，连锁最多两次额外攻击。

items.name: Winter's Wrath
items.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis staff. While your Super is active:

[Super Primary]  : Cast out a barrage of [Stasis] Stasis shards that freeze targets.

[Super Secondary]  : Cast out a shockwave that shatters all frozen targets.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一根冰影法杖。当超能激活时：

[超能主技能] ：施放由冰影碎片组成的弹幕，冻结敌人。

[超能附技能] ：施放一个震荡波，粉碎所有被冻结的敌人。

items.name: Balanced Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以适当的速度和方向控制开始空中漂移。

items.name: Burst Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以强大的初始爆发速度开始空中漂移。

items.name: Strafe Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并凭借强劲的方向控制开始空中漂移。

items.name: Transcendence
items.description:
Achieve harmony by dealing damage with Light and Dark damage types in equal measure or by applying subclass buffs to your allies. Kinetic damage generates both Light and Dark energy.

While Transcendence is active, your grenade is replaced by a unique Prismatic grenade that deals both Light and Dark damage. Dealing melee damage while transcendent greatly increases your grenade energy regeneration, and vice versa. Defeating targets while transcendent extends its duration.
items.descriptionZh:
通过等量使用光能与暗影伤害类型造成伤害或对你的盟友施加分支职业增益来实现和谐。动能伤害会同时生成光能与暗影能量。

当超凡状态生效时，你的手雷会被替换为同时造成光能与暗影伤害的独特棱镜手雷。处于超凡状态时，造成近战伤害会大幅提升手雷能量回复速度，反之亦然。处于超凡状态时，击败目标可延长其持续时间。

items.name: Triple Jump
items.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时进行第二次或第三次跳跃可保持在空中。

items.name: Strafe Jump
items.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时凭借强劲的方向控制再次进行跳跃。

items.name: High Jump
items.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中时再次跳跃可上升到更高的高度。

items.name: Gathering Storm
items.description:
Hurl your Arc Staff forward, embedding it into surfaces or large targets and jolting nearby targets.

After a short time, a devastating lightning bolt strikes the staff, overcharging it with Arc energy. While overcharged, your staff discharges lightning at nearby foes.
items.descriptionZh:
将你的电弧法杖向前抛出，将其嵌在表面或大型目标上，震颤附近的目标。

短时间后，一道毁灭性的闪电将击中法杖，使其被电弧能量过充。在过充时，你的法杖会对附近的敌人放出闪电。

items.name: Arc Staff
items.description:
Form a staff of pure Arc energy and acrobatically take out your foes.

[Block] : Hold to deflect incoming projectiles with your Arc staff.

Deflecting a projectile grants you a stack of Bolt Charge.

Heavy attack combos and airborne heavy slams blind targets.
items.descriptionZh:
生成一支充斥着纯粹电弧能量的法杖，华丽地击杀你的敌人。

[格挡]：按住来用你的电弧法杖抵挡来袭的射弹。

抵挡射弹会为你提供一层电光充能。

重攻击连击和空中猛击重攻击会致盲目标。

items.name: Storm's Edge
items.description:
Summon an electrified dagger and throw it in your aim direction.

When the dagger hits a surface or a target, you blink to its location and perform a powerful whirling strike, damaging any nearby targets. Can be reactivated after the strike to perform additional throws.

If the dagger flies for long enough without impacting anything, it detonates and you blink to the detonation location.
items.descriptionZh:
召唤一把透电匕首，朝瞄准的方向投出。

当匕首命中某个表面或目标时，你会瞬移至其位置并施展强力旋风打击，对任何附近目标造成伤害。打击后可重新激活施展额外投掷。

匕首在未命中任何对象的情况下飞行足够远的距离后会引爆，而你将会瞬移至引爆位置。

perkDetails.name: Echo of Cessation
perkDetails.description:
Finisher final blows create a burst of Void damage that causes nearby combatants to become volatile.

Defeating volatile targets creates a Void Breach.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
终结技最后一击会制造一次虚空伤害爆发，使附近战斗人员获得不稳定效果。

击败不稳定目标会制造一个虚空裂口。

perkDetails.name: Echo of Vigilance
perkDetails.description: Defeating a target while your shields are depleted grants you a temporary Void overshield.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 护盾耗尽时击败一个目标，就会获得一个临时的虚空覆盖护盾。

perkDetails.name: Diamond Lance
perkDetails.description:
Shatter or defeat targets with [Stasis] Stasis abilities or weapons to create a Stasis lance.

[Shoot]  : Throw the lance to freeze targets on impact.

[Melee]  : Slam the lance to the ground to freeze targets in a small area.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
碎裂或使用冰影技能或武器击败目标以生成冰影长矛。

[射击]  ：投掷长矛以冻结被击中的目标。

[近战]  ：使用长矛猛击地面以冻结小范围内的目标。

items.name: Arcbolt Grenade
items.description: A grenade that chains bolts of lightning to nearby targets.
items.descriptionZh: 在附近目标之间引起连锁闪电的手雷。

items.name: Suppressor Grenade
items.description: An explosive grenade that suppresses, preventing targets from using abilities for a short time.
items.descriptionZh: 一种能造成 压制效果的高爆手雷，可以使目标在短时间内无法使用 技能。

items.name: Marksman's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
items.descriptionZh: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

items.name: Gambler's Dodge
items.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
items.descriptionZh: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

items.name: Thermite Grenade
items.description: A grenade that sends forth a burning line of fire, dealing damage and scorching targets in its path.
items.descriptionZh: 能向前发射一道燃烧火焰的手雷，对路径上的目标造成伤害及灼烧效果。

items.name: Threadling Grenade
items.description: A woven projectile that reweaves itself into Threadlings while in flight.
items.descriptionZh: 一种会在飞行中将其自身重新编织为线虫的编织射弹。

items.name: Knife Trick
items.description: Throw a fan of flaming knives that scorch targets on hit.
items.descriptionZh: 投掷烈火刀扇， 灼烧 命中的目标。

items.name: Proximity Explosive Knife
items.description: Throw a knife that attaches to surfaces upon impact and explodes when it detects a nearby target.
items.descriptionZh: 丢出一把飞刀，接触时附着于表面并在侦测到附近的目标时爆炸。

items.name: Lightweight Knife
items.description: Quickly throw a knife that deals moderate damage. Precision hits with this knife make you radiant for a short duration.
items.descriptionZh: 快速投掷一把飞刀造成中等伤害。使用此飞刀精准命中可在短时间内获得焕光效果。

items.name: Weighted Throwing Knife
items.description:
Throw a knife that deals extra precision damage and causes scorched targets to ignite.

Precision final blows with this knife immediately recharge your class ability.
items.descriptionZh:
投掷一把飞刀造成额外精准伤害并点燃被灼烧的目标。

使用此飞刀造成精准最后一击可立即重新充能职业技能。

items.name: Duskfield Grenade
items.description: A grenade that shatters on impact, leaving behind a field that slows targets and freezes those who do not leave the volume.
items.descriptionZh: 手雷会在撞击时碎裂，留下一片减速目标的力场，未离开力场范围的敌人会被冻结。

items.name: Frenzied Blade
items.description: Activate your charged melee ability to dash forward, slashing at targets in front of you and severing them.
items.descriptionZh: 激活你的充能近战技能向前猛冲，猛击你面前的目标并割裂他们。

items.name: Burst Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以强大的初始爆发速度开始空中漂移。

items.name: Strafe Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并凭借强劲的方向控制开始空中漂移。

items.name: Balanced Glide
items.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
items.descriptionZh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以适当的速度和方向控制开始空中漂移。

perkDetails.name: Ember of Resolve
perkDetails.description: Solar grenade final blows cure you.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 烈日手雷最后一击可获得治愈效果。

perkDetails.name: Ember of Mercy
perkDetails.description:
When you revive an ally, you and other nearby allies gain restoration.

Picking up a Firesprite grants restoration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
当你复活盟友时，你和其他附近盟友将获得恢复效果。

拾取焰灵可赋予恢复效果。

perkDetails.name: +10 Health ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Health ▲
perkDetails.descriptionZh: +10 生命值 ▲

perkDetails.name: Touch of Winter
perkDetails.description:
Your Glacier, Duskfield, Coldsnap, and Shatter grenades have enhanced functionality.

Glacier Grenade: Adds a [Stasis] Stasis crystal and changes the formation.

Duskfield Grenade: Increases slow-field size and creates a small [Stasis] Stasis crystal on impact.

Coldsnap Grenade: Seekers duplicate after freezing a target and create a [Stasis] Stasis crystal on detonation.

Shatter Grenade: Creates additional shrapnel projectiles on detonation. Hitting frozen targets with this grenade refunds some grenade energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你的冰川、暮域、急冻和碎裂手雷的功能增强。

冰川手雷：增加一个冰影水晶，并改变其结构。

暮域手雷：扩大减速力场的范围，并在撞击时生成一个小冰影水晶。

急冻手雷：追踪弹在冻结目标后将会复制，并在引爆时生成冰影水晶。

碎裂手雷：引爆时产生额外碎片射弹。用此手雷命中被冻结的目标会返还部分手雷能量。

perkDetails.name: Flow State
perkDetails.description:
Defeating a jolted target makes you amplified.

While you are amplified, your dodge recharges more quickly, you are more resilient while dodging, and your reload speed is greatly increased.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
击败一名震颤的目标会使你进入增幅状态。

在增幅状态下，你的闪身充能更快，闪身时韧性更高，填装速度大幅上升。

perkDetails.name: Tempest Strike
perkDetails.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to unleash a devastating uppercut attack that travels along the ground in front of you, damaging and jolting targets it hits.

Defeating jolted targets grants a stack of Bolt Charge.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
在滑行时，激活你的充能近战技能，沿着你前方的地面施展一次毁灭性的上挑攻击，对命中的目标造成伤害并使其震颤。

击败被震颤的目标可提供一层电光充能。

perkDetails.name: Lethal Current
perkDetails.description:
After dodging, your next melee attack has increased lunge range, jolts the target, and creates a damaging aftershock.

Damaging any jolted target with melee attacks also blinds them.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
在闪身之后，下一记近战攻击会增加前冲距离，使目标震颤，并产生破坏性的余震。

使用近战攻击对任何震颤的目标造成伤害，也会使其致盲。

perkDetails.name: Ascension
perkDetails.description:
[Air Move]  While airborne, consume your class ability energy to summon your Arc Staff, propelling yourself upward and creating a burst of energy around you that amplifies allies and jolts targets.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
[空中移动]  在空中时，消耗你的职业技能能量来召唤电弧法杖，推动自身向上并在四周生成增幅盟友和震颤目标的能量爆发。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

items.name: Flux Grenade
items.description: An explosive grenade that attaches to targets.
items.descriptionZh: 可粘附在目标身上的高爆手雷。

perkDetails.name: Thread of Propagation
perkDetails.description: Powered melee final blows grant your [Strand] Strand weapons Unraveling Rounds.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 充能近战最后一击会赋予你的缚丝武器瓦解弹药。

perkDetails.name: +10 Melee ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Melee ▲

perkDetails.name: Thread of Evolution
perkDetails.description: Threadlings travel farther and deal additional damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 线虫可移动得更远并造成额外伤害。

perkDetails.name: +10 Super ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Super ▲

perkDetails.name: Thread of Ascent
perkDetails.description: Activating your grenade ability reloads your equipped weapon and grants bonus airborne effectiveness and handling for a short duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 激活你的手雷技能会填装你已装备的武器并在短时间内提供额外的空中效率和操控性。

perkDetails.name: +10 Weapon ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Weapon ▲

perkDetails.name: Thread of Finality
perkDetails.description: Finisher final blows create Threadlings.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 终结技最后一击会生成线虫。

perkDetails.name: +10 Class ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Class ▲

perkDetails.name: Thread of Mind
perkDetails.description: Defeating suspended targets grants class ability energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击败悬停的目标可回复职业技能能量。

perkDetails.name: Thread of Fury
perkDetails.description: Damaging targets with a Tangle grants melee energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用缠结对目标造成伤害可回复近战能量。

perkDetails.name: -10 Melee ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Melee ▼

perkDetails.name: Thread of Rebirth
perkDetails.description: [Strand] Strand weapon final blows have a chance to create a Threadling.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 缚丝武器最后一击有几率生成一个线虫。

perkDetails.name: Thread of Transmutation
perkDetails.description: While you have Woven Mail, weapon final blows create a Tangle.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 处于织造铠甲状态时，武器最后一击会生成一个缠结。

perkDetails.name: +10 Melee ▲
perkDetails.description: +10 Melee ▲

perkDetails.name: Thread of Warding
perkDetails.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Woven Mail.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会提供织造铠甲。

perkDetails.name: -10 Health ▼
perkDetails.description: -10 Health ▼
perkDetails.descriptionZh: -10 生命值 ▼

perkDetails.name: Thread of Wisdom
perkDetails.description: Defeating suspended targets creates an Orb of Power.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击败悬停的目标会生成一个能量球。

items.name: Shield Throw
items.description: Hurl your Void Shield toward a target. The shield can ricochet off targets and surfaces, granting Overshield for each target hit.
items.descriptionZh: 向目标投掷你的虚空护盾。盾牌可在目标和表面弹射，每击中一个目标都会赋予覆盖护盾。

items.name: Shield Bash
items.description: After sprinting for a short time, use this melee ability to unleash a devastating Shield Bash that suppresses the target. Final blows with Shield Bash grant an Overshield.
items.descriptionZh: 短时间冲刺后，使用此近战技能释放出极具破坏力的圣盾强袭来压制目标。使用圣盾强袭完成最后一击赋予覆盖护盾。

items.name: Threadling Grenade
items.description: A woven projectile that reweaves itself into Threadlings while in flight.
items.descriptionZh: 一种会在飞行中将其自身重新编织为线虫的编织射弹。

items.name: Storm Grenade
items.description: A grenade that calls down a focused lightning storm.
items.descriptionZh: 能够引起一场集中的闪电风暴的手雷。

perkDetails.name: Whirling Maelstrom
perkDetails.description: Destroying a Tangle will weave a violent, writhing mass of [Strand] Strand fibers. The Strand mass seeks out and damages targets, emitting Unraveling projectiles when it defeats them.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 摧毁缠结会织出一团猛烈扭动的缚丝纤维。缚丝纤维团会寻找目标并对其造成伤害，在目标被击败后发出瓦解射弹。

perkDetails.name: Threaded Specter
perkDetails.description:
Activating your class ability leaves behind a decoy woven from [Strand] Strand matter that draws the attention of nearby combatants.

After taking significant damage or when combatants approach, the decoy detonates, dealing damage and releasing Threadlings that seek out and attack nearby foes.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活你的职业技能将留下一个由缚丝物质编织的诱饵，吸引附近战斗人员的注意。

在受到高额伤害或战斗人员接近时，诱饵会自动引爆，造成伤害并释放出能追寻并攻击附近敌人的线虫。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perkDetails.name: Ensnaring Slam
perkDetails.description:
Activate your air move to consume your class ability energy and dive to the ground, suspending all nearby targets on impact.

Suspending combatants with this ability grants you Woven Mail.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活空中移动来消耗你的职业技能能量并朝地面俯冲，悬停附近所有的目标。

使用此技能悬停战斗人员可为你提供织造铠甲。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perkDetails.name: Widow's Silk
perkDetails.description:
You have an additional grenade charge.

Your Grappling Hook creates a Grapple Tangle at the grapple point.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你拥有一次额外手雷充能。

你的抓钩会在抓取点生成一个抓取缠结。

items.name: Sentinel Shield
items.description:
[Super]  : Summon a shield of Void Light. 
While Sentinel Shield is active:
[Light Attack]  : Attack.
[Block]  : Block.
[Grenade]  : Perform a Shield Throw.

Guard with Sentinel Shield to create a defensive wall that draws hostile fire. Allies behind the shield have increased survivability, weapon damage, and passive reload.

Guarding allies and blocking damage makes the shield last longer and increases your Shield Throw damage.
items.descriptionZh:
[超能]  ：召唤一面虚空光能圣盾。
哨兵圣盾生效时：
[轻攻击]  ：攻击。
[格挡]  ：格挡。
[手雷]  ：进行圣盾投掷。

用哨兵圣盾防御来制造一堵可以吸引敌人火力的防护墙。处于护盾后方的盟友将获得更高的生存能力、武器伤害和被动填装。

为盟友防御和阻挡伤害会延长护盾持续时间并提升你的圣盾投掷伤害。

items.name: Ward of Dawn
items.description:
Create a protective dome for you and your allies.

While inside Ward of Dawn, allies gain Void overshield and increased weapon damage, while targets inside the Ward are weakened.

The Ward's owner also gains increased melee damage while inside and can pick up and throw the Ward's core to reposition the Ward up to two times.
items.descriptionZh:
为你和你的盟友制造一个防护圆顶护罩。

你和你的盟友处在黎明护罩中时，会获得虚空覆盖护盾并且提升武器伤害，护罩内的目标则会被削弱。

护罩的制造者在护罩中时还会获得近战伤害提升，并且可以拾取并投掷护罩核心，以此重新放置护罩，最多两次。

items.name: Twilight Arsenal
items.description:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.
items.descriptionZh:
[超能]  ：召唤三把虚空战斧并依次将其扔向敌人。命中时，战斧会拉近附近的目标，然后造成具有削弱效果的爆炸。爆炸后，战斧可以被你或盟友拾起，在短时间内作为武器使用。

携带一把虚空战斧时：
[轻攻击]  ：向前挥斩，造成伤害并削弱目标。
[重攻击]  ：投掷战斧，耗尽战斧的剩余弹药。

items.name: Coldsnap Grenade
items.description: A grenade that freezes on impact and sends another seeker to find and freeze targets.
items.descriptionZh: 手雷命中后会冻结敌人并释放另一颗跟踪雷来寻找并冻结目标。
